title: 9 Days Sri Lanka Beach & Wildlife Adventure
overview:
Experience the ultimate Sri Lanka beach wildlife tour, a perfectly designed 9-day journey that combines beaches, wildlife, and scenic landscapes. This tour is ideal for travelers who want both relaxation and adventure in one seamless itinerary.

First, your journey begins in Colombo. Here, you will explore a vibrant city filled with history, culture, and colonial landmarks. After that, you travel south toward Bentota and Hikkaduwa. These destinations are known for their golden beaches and calm coastal atmosphere. In addition, you will enjoy a Madu River safari, turtle conservation visits, and exciting water sports.

Next, the journey continues to Galle Fort. This UNESCO World Heritage site offers charming streets, boutique shops, and stunning ocean views. Meanwhile, Mirissa provides a completely different experience. Here, you can enjoy whale and dolphin watching, which is one of the highlights of any Sri Lanka beach wildlife tour.

After the coast, the adventure shifts inland. You will visit Yala National Park, one of the best wildlife reserves in Asia. During the safari, you may spot leopards, elephants, and a wide variety of bird species. Therefore, this adds an exciting wildlife dimension to your journey.

Following this, you head into the hill country. Ella and Nuwara Eliya offer cooler climates, lush tea plantations, and breathtaking views. In particular, the scenic train ride through the mountains is considered one of the most beautiful journeys in the world.

Finally, your Sri Lanka beach wildlife tour concludes with an adventure in Kitulgala. Here, you can enjoy white-water rafting surrounded by rainforest scenery. Afterward, return to Colombo for departure.

Overall, this tour is perfect for couples, families, and explorers. It offers a balanced mix of beaches, wildlife, and cultural experiences across Sri Lanka.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Colombo City Experience
itinerary.body: Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred to Colombo, the vibrant commercial capital of Sri Lanka. Depending on your arrival time, enjoy a guided city tour covering major highlights including Independence Square, Colombo National Museum, Gangaramaya Temple, Seema Malakaya, and the iconic Red Mosque. Conclude your day with a relaxing walk along Galle Face Green, where you can witness a stunning sunset over the Indian Ocean. Overnight stay in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Colombo to Bentota – River Safari & Coastal Adventure
itinerary.body: After breakfast, journey south along the scenic coastal road to Bentota. Experience the famous Madu River Safari, where you will explore mangrove forests, small islands, and diverse wildlife ecosystems. Visit a turtle hatchery to learn about conservation efforts protecting endangered sea turtles. In the afternoon, enjoy optional water sports such as jet skiing, banana rides, snorkeling, and river cruises. Relax by the beach as the day ends. Overnight stay in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Bentota to Hikkaduwa – Coral Reefs & Marine Life
itinerary.body: Continue your journey to Hikkaduwa, one of Sri Lanka’s top beach destinations. Visit the Hikkaduwa Coral Sanctuary and enjoy a glass-bottom boat ride to witness vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish. You can also go snorkeling in calm, shallow waters for a closer experience with marine life. Spend the evening relaxing by the beach. Overnight stay in Hikkaduwa.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Hikkaduwa – Galle – Mirissa Coastal Escape
itinerary.body: Travel to Galle and explore the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, a historic colonial city with charming streets, boutique shops, and ocean views. Continue to Mirissa, stopping at Coconut Tree Hill for panoramic coastal views. Visit Secret Beach and Parrot Rock, both offering unique perspectives of Sri Lanka’s southern coastline. Enjoy a relaxing evening by the beach. Overnight stay in Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Mirissa to Yala – Whale Watching & Cultural Journey
itinerary.body: Start your day early with an optional whale and dolphin watching excursion (seasonal: November to April), where you may spot blue whales, sperm whales, and playful dolphins. Afterward, visit the Hummanaya Blowhole, one of the largest blowholes in the world. Continue your journey inland to Yala, stopping at Kataragama Temple, an important spiritual site. Overnight stay in Yala.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Yala Safari – Journey to Ella
itinerary.body: Begin the day with an early morning safari in Yala National Park, renowned for its high density of leopards, elephants, sloth bears, and diverse birdlife. After the safari, travel to Ella through scenic mountain roads. En route, visit Ravana Falls and Ravana Cave, both linked to ancient Sri Lankan legends. Arrive in Ella and relax amidst the cool hill country climate. Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Ella to Nuwara Eliya – Scenic Train Journey
itinerary.body: Start your day with a visit to the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most photographed landmarks. Then board the famous scenic train ride from Ella to Nanu Oya, considered one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world. Upon arrival, explore Nuwara Eliya, including Gregory Lake and the historic Old Post Office. Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Nuwara Eliya to Kitulgala – Waterfalls & Adventure
itinerary.body: Travel through the lush tea country, stopping at Devon Falls and St. Clair’s Falls, often referred to as the “Little Niagara of Sri Lanka.” Continue to Kitulgala, a rainforest region known for adventure activities. Enjoy an exciting white water rafting experience on the Kelani River, surrounded by dense jungle scenery. Overnight stay in Kitulgala.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Departure – Return to Colombo
itinerary.body: After breakfast, transfer back to Colombo via the scenic route. Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy a short city stop or shopping experience before heading to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your unforgettable Sri Lanka journey.

title: 7-Day Kenya Safari Adventure
overview:
Embark on an unforgettable journey with our 7-Day Kenya Safari Adventure, a perfectly curated experience that takes you deep into Kenya’s most iconic landscapes—Amboseli National Park, Ol Pejeta Conservancy, and the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. Designed for travelers seeking an immersive and personal safari, this journey combines wildlife, conservation, and cultural experiences into one seamless adventure.

Your safari begins in Amboseli National Park, where vast open plains stretch beneath the majestic silhouette of Mount Kilimanjaro. Known for its large elephant herds and breathtaking scenery, Amboseli offers exceptional wildlife encounters. Enjoy thrilling game drives where you can spot lions, cheetahs, giraffes, and Amboseli’s famous giant-tusked elephants, all set against one of Africa’s most iconic backdrops.

From here, journey north to the remarkable Ol Pejeta Conservancy, one of Kenya’s leading conservation areas. This unique destination is home to the Big Five and the largest population of black rhinos in East Africa. You’ll also visit the Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary, the only place in Kenya where you can observe rescued chimpanzees. A guided walking safari allows you to connect with nature on a deeper level, offering a rare and intimate wildlife experience.

The adventure culminates in the legendary Masai Mara National Reserve, where endless savannah plains host one of the richest ecosystems on earth. Here, you’ll embark on full-day game drives in search of the Big Five and witness extraordinary wildlife interactions. During migration season, the Mara becomes the stage for one of nature’s most dramatic spectacles.

With private 4×4 transport, expert guides, and flexible itineraries, this safari delivers a truly authentic and unforgettable African experience.

title: 7-Day Sopa Lodges Circuit Safari
overview:
Experience the best of Kenya’s wildlife and landscapes with our 7-Day Sopa Lodges Circuit Safari, a well-balanced mid-range adventure that combines comfort, value, and unforgettable safari experiences. This carefully designed itinerary takes you through Kenya’s most iconic destinations, offering a rich blend of wildlife encounters, scenic beauty, and cultural exploration.

Your journey begins in Amboseli National Park, one of Kenya’s most breathtaking safari destinations, set against the majestic backdrop of Mount Kilimanjaro. Known for its large elephant herds and diverse ecosystems, Amboseli offers excellent opportunities to spot wildlife including lions, giraffes, zebras, and a wide variety of bird species. Game drives here provide incredible photography opportunities, especially with Kilimanjaro towering in the distance.

Next, travel through the scenic Great Rift Valley to the tranquil waters of Lake Naivasha, a freshwater lake surrounded by lush greenery and rich birdlife. Enjoy a relaxing boat safari where you can observe hippos and numerous bird species, followed by a visit to nearby sanctuaries for a unique walking safari experience.

Continue to Hell’s Gate National Park, one of the few parks in Kenya where you can explore on foot or by bicycle, surrounded by dramatic cliffs, gorges, and geothermal activity. The journey then proceeds to Lake Nakuru National Park, a renowned sanctuary famous for its flamingos and thriving population of black and white rhinos.

The highlight of your safari unfolds in the legendary Masai Mara National Reserve, where vast savannah plains are home to the Big Five and countless other wildlife species. Enjoy thrilling game drives and immerse yourself in the raw beauty of the African wilderness, with opportunities to witness the Great Migration during the season.

With comfortable stays at Sopa lodges, professional guides, and seamless travel, this safari offers the perfect balance of comfort, adventure, and authentic Kenyan experiences.

You may also explore nearby areas such as Crescent Island, where you can walk among freely roaming giraffes, zebras, and other wildlife in a serene natural environment.

The park is famous for its flamingos and diverse birdlife, as well as its strong conservation efforts protecting endangered black and white rhinos. Explore a variety of landscapes including lake shores, woodlands, and grasslands.

Enjoy game drives where you can encounter lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, buffaloes, and a wide range of other wildlife species.

The Masai Mara is renowned for its exceptional wildlife density and the Great Migration, one of the most extraordinary natural events in the world. Experience game drives across vast savannah plains where you can encounter the Big Five—lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo, and rhino—along with many other species.

overview:

This premium safari combines two of Kenya’s most iconic destinations—Amboseli National Park and the Masai Mara—while offering the unique advantage of scenic domestic flights that elevate your experience both literally and visually.

title: 4-Day Luxury Masai Mara, Lake Naivasha Safari
overview:

title: 10-Day Off The Beaten Path Kenya Safari (Meru, Samburu, Ol Pejeta & Masai Mara)
overview:
Step beyond the ordinary and discover Kenya’s hidden gems with our 10-Day Off The Beaten Path Kenya Safari, a unique journey designed for travelers seeking a deeper, more authentic African experience. This exclusive itinerary takes you away from the typical safari routes and into some of Kenya’s most remote and diverse wilderness areas, combining raw beauty, rich wildlife, and meaningful conservation encounters.

Your adventure begins in the lush and untamed landscapes of Meru National Park, a lesser-known treasure famous for its rivers, dense vegetation, and abundant wildlife. This peaceful park offers excellent opportunities to spot elephants, buffalo, giraffes, and leopards without the crowds, making it ideal for a more intimate safari experience.

Continue north to the rugged terrain of Samburu National Reserve, a semi-arid region home to the unique “Samburu Special Five,” including Grevy’s zebra, reticulated giraffe, and gerenuk. The dramatic landscapes and strong cultural presence of the Samburu people create a safari experience unlike any other.

Your journey then leads to the renowned Ol Pejeta Conservancy, a leading conservation area known for its thriving rhino population and the famous chimpanzee sanctuary. Here, you’ll gain insight into wildlife protection efforts while enjoying exciting game drives and optional walking safaris.

The safari culminates in the legendary Masai Mara National Reserve, where vast savannah plains host one of Africa’s richest ecosystems. Spend multiple days exploring the Mara in search of the Big Five and witnessing incredible wildlife interactions, including the Great Migration during the season.

With private 4×4 transport, expert guides, and carefully selected accommodations, this safari offers a rare opportunity to explore Kenya beyond the usual routes—perfect for adventurous travelers seeking something truly special.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Nairobi to Meru National Park
itinerary.body:
Scenic Journey to Meru

Your exclusive safari journey begins in Nairobi as you travel north through the lush landscapes of central Kenya, passing through Thika and Nyeri. The journey gradually unfolds into the untamed wilderness of Meru National Park — one of Kenya’s most remote and unspoiled safari destinations.

Meru Safari Experience

Arrive in time for lunch and later enjoy your first game drive in this lesser-explored park, known for its rivers, dense vegetation, and rich biodiversity. This is a destination for true safari enthusiasts seeking privacy and authenticity.

Discover highlights such as Adamson’s Falls and the park’s rhino sanctuary, adding both scenic beauty and conservation significance to your experience.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your camp for a relaxing evening and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Meru to Samburu National Reserve

After breakfast, continue north to the dramatic semi-arid landscapes of Samburu National Reserve, a region known for its unique wildlife and cultural richness.

Samburu Safari Experience

Arrive in time for lunch, followed by an afternoon game drive along the Ewaso Nyiro River, where elephants, crocodiles, and elusive predators such as leopards are often seen.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your lodge for dinner and overnight stay in this rugged and scenic environment.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Full-Day Safari in Samburu
itinerary.body:
Search for the Samburu Special Five

Spend the day exploring Samburu with extended game drives. Look out for the unique “Samburu Special Five” — Grevy’s zebra, reticulated giraffe, Beisa oryx, Somali ostrich, and gerenuk — species rarely found elsewhere.

The region’s striking landscapes and strong cultural presence make this a truly distinctive safari experience.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your lodge for a relaxed evening and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Samburu to Ol Pejeta Conservancy

Ol Pejeta Safari Experience

Arrive in time for lunch, followed by an afternoon game drive. This conservancy is home to the largest population of rhinos in Kenya, along with the Big Five and a rich diversity of wildlife.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your camp for dinner and overnight stay.

Return to your lodge for a refined evening and overnight stay.

Return to your lodge for a premium dining experience and overnight stay.

title: 9-Day Wildlife & Diani Beach Safari
overview:
Experience the ultimate Kenyan journey with our 9-Day Wildlife & Diani Beach Safari, a perfectly balanced adventure that combines thrilling wildlife encounters with serene coastal relaxation. This carefully crafted itinerary takes you through Kenya’s most iconic safari destinations before ending in the tropical paradise of Diani Beach.

Your adventure begins in the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve, where vast savannahs are home to the legendary Big Five—lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino. Enjoy immersive game drives guided by experts who help you track wildlife across one of Africa’s richest ecosystems. During migration season, witness the dramatic crossing of wildebeest and zebras, one of nature’s greatest spectacles.

Next, journey through the scenic Great Rift Valley to the tranquil shores of Lake Naivasha, where you’ll enjoy a relaxing boat safari among hippos and vibrant birdlife. A guided walking safari on Crescent Island offers a rare opportunity to walk among giraffes, zebras, and antelopes in a peaceful natural setting.

Continue to Amboseli National Park, famous for its large elephant herds and breathtaking views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Game drives here offer incredible photography opportunities, with elephants roaming against the backdrop of Africa’s highest peak.

The final highlight of your journey takes you from the wild savannah to the pristine shores of Diani Beach, one of Africa’s most beautiful coastal destinations. Relax on white sandy beaches, swim in turquoise waters, or enjoy optional activities such as snorkeling, dolphin tours, and sunset dhow cruises.

With private transport, expert guides, and carefully selected accommodations, this safari offers the perfect combination of adventure, relaxation, and unforgettable African experiences.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Relax at your lakeside lodge and enjoy a refined evening overlooking the calm waters.

Amboseli Scenic Experience

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your lodge for dinner and overnight stay in this stunning natural setting.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Dinner & Overnight Experience

itinerary.title: Day 8: Diani Beach – Leisure Day

Relaxation & Optional Activities

Enjoy another full day at leisure. Explore coral reefs on a glass-bottom boat, visit Kaya Kinondo Sacred Forest, or experience activities such as kite surfing, camel rides, or a traditional sunset dhow cruise.

Dinner & Overnight Experience

Return to your resort for a relaxing evening and overnight stay by the ocean.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Departure
itinerary.body:
Farewell to Kenya

Enjoy your final morning by the beach before breakfast. Afterward, transfer to Ukunda Airstrip for your flight back to Nairobi to connect with your international departure.

End of Safari Experience

As your journey concludes, take with you unforgettable memories of Kenya’s wildlife, landscapes, and coastal beauty.

title: 3-Day Mid-Range Masai Mara & Lake Naivasha Safari
overview:
Discover the essence of Kenya’s wildlife and natural beauty with our 3-Day Mid-Range Masai Mara & Lake Naivasha Safari, a perfectly crafted short getaway ideal for travelers who want an immersive safari experience within a limited time. This journey combines the world-renowned Masai Mara with the serene landscapes of Lake Naivasha, offering a balance of adventure and relaxation.

Your safari begins with a scenic drive from Nairobi through the breathtaking Great Rift Valley, where panoramic viewpoints provide stunning photo opportunities. The journey continues to the legendary Masai Mara National Reserve, one of Africa’s most celebrated wildlife destinations. Known for its vast open plains and incredible biodiversity, the Mara is home to the iconic Big Five—lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino—along with cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and countless other species.

Enjoy thrilling game drives led by experienced guides who help you track wildlife and understand their natural behaviors. During the migration season (July to October), you may witness one of nature’s greatest spectacles as millions of wildebeests and zebras cross the Mara River in search of greener pastures.

On the final day, journey to the tranquil shores of Lake Naivasha, a freshwater lake nestled in the Rift Valley. Here, you’ll enjoy a relaxing boat ride among hippos and diverse birdlife, followed by an optional walking safari on Crescent Island, where you can walk among freely roaming wildlife in a safe environment.

With comfortable mid-range accommodation, private transport, and personalized service, this safari offers an unforgettable introduction to Kenya’s diverse landscapes and wildlife.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Nairobi to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.body:
Pick-Up from Nairobi & Scenic Drive

Your journey begins in the morning with a scenic drive from Nairobi towards the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve. En route, enjoy a stop at the Great Rift Valley escarpment for breathtaking panoramic views and photo opportunities. Continue through rolling farmlands and rural landscapes, offering a glimpse into Kenya’s countryside.

Arrival & Lunch at Lodge/Camp

Arrive at your mid-range lodge or tented camp in time for lunch. Settle into your comfortable accommodation surrounded by nature and prepare for your first safari experience.

Afternoon Game Drive in Masai Mara

Embark on your first game drive in one of Africa’s most iconic wildlife reserves. The Masai Mara is home to the legendary Big Five—lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino—along with cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, and a wide variety of antelope species. The vast open savannah and acacia-dotted plains provide exceptional opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography.

Evening Relaxation & Overnight Stay

Return to your lodge or camp at sunset, where you can unwind by the campfire and enjoy a freshly prepared dinner. As night falls, experience the magic of the African wilderness with distant wildlife sounds under a starlit sky.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full-Day Game Drive in Masai Mara
itinerary.body:
Full-Day Safari Experience

After breakfast, set out for a full-day game drive across the expansive plains of the Masai Mara. This reserve is a photographer’s paradise, offering golden lighting and extraordinary opportunities to observe wildlife in their natural habitat—from predators on the hunt to herds grazing peacefully across the savannah.

During the Great Migration season (July to October), witness one of the world’s most dramatic natural spectacles, as vast numbers of wildebeests, zebras, and gazelles cross the Mara River in search of greener pastures. Even outside migration season, the Masai Mara offers exceptional wildlife viewing year-round.

Picnic Lunch by the Mara River

Enjoy a scenic picnic lunch near the Mara River, where you may spot hippos and crocodiles while taking in the surrounding natural beauty.

Explore Diverse Regions of the Reserve

Continue your safari through different regions such as Olare Orok and Musiara, each known for unique ecosystems and abundant wildlife diversity.

Optional Maasai Cultural Visit

You may choose to visit a traditional Maasai village (optional activity) to experience authentic local culture, including traditional dances, customs, and handcrafted beadwork.

Return to Lodge & Evening at Leisure

Return to your camp for dinner and enjoy a relaxed evening surrounded by the sights and sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Masai Mara to Lake Naivasha & Return to Nairobi
itinerary.body:
Departure to Lake Naivasha

After breakfast, depart Masai Mara and journey towards Lake Naivasha, a tranquil freshwater lake located in Kenya’s Great Rift Valley. Enjoy scenic views of rolling hills, escarpments, and rural landscapes along the way.

Boat Safari on Lake Naivasha

Upon arrival, enjoy a relaxing boat ride across Lake Naivasha. Spot hippos, waterbucks, and a variety of bird species including African fish eagles, pelicans, and cormorants. The peaceful surroundings provide a refreshing contrast to the open plains of the Masai Mara.

Walking Safari at Crescent Island Sanctuary

Visit Crescent Island Game Sanctuary, where you can enjoy a guided walking safari among freely roaming giraffes, zebras, and antelopes in a safe and natural environment—an intimate wildlife experience perfect for nature lovers.

Lunch & Return to Nairobi

After your Naivasha experience, enjoy a leisurely lunch at a lakeside restaurant before proceeding back to Nairobi. You will be dropped off at your hotel, residence, or airport, marking the end of your unforgettable Kenya safari journey.

Surrounded by lush landscapes and abundant birdlife, this tranquil destination offers a refreshing start to your safari. Enjoy a relaxing boat ride across the lake, where you can spot hippos and a wide variety of birds, followed by a guided walking safari in a nearby animal sanctuary for a closer look at wildlife.

Next, continue to Lake Nakuru National Park, a sanctuary famous for its large populations of both black and white rhinos. The park is also home to flamingos, pelicans, giraffes, and other wildlife, making it one of the best places in Kenya for birdwatching and rhino sightings.

The highlight of your safari awaits in the world-renowned Maasai Mara National Reserve, where vast savannahs and incredible wildlife encounters define the experience. Enjoy thrilling game drives in search of the Big Five—lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino—along with countless other species. Enhance your journey with a cultural experience led by Maasai warriors, offering insight into one of Africa’s most fascinating communities. With comfortable accommodation, professional guides, and unforgettable landscapes, this safari promises an authentic and memorable African adventure.

title: 1-Day Best of Nairobi City Excursion
overview:
Experience the dynamic energy of Kenya’s capital with our 1-Day Best of Nairobi City Excursion, a perfectly curated journey that combines wildlife, culture, and urban exploration into one unforgettable day. Designed for travelers with limited time, this excursion offers a unique opportunity to witness Nairobi’s incredible contrasts — where modern city life meets untamed nature.

Your adventure begins early in the morning with a pick-up from your hotel or residence in a comfortable 4×4 safari vehicle. The day kicks off with an exciting game drive in Nairobi National Park, the only national park located within a capital city. Here, you’ll have the chance to spot lions, rhinos, giraffes, zebras, and more, all set against the striking backdrop of Nairobi’s skyline.

Next, you’ll visit the renowned David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe rescued baby elephants during their feeding session and learn about ongoing conservation efforts. This heartwarming experience offers a deeper understanding of Kenya’s commitment to wildlife protection.

A highlight of the day includes a delicious lunch at the famous Carnivore Restaurant, known for its unique dining experience and variety of grilled meats, with vegetarian options available.

In the afternoon, enjoy a close encounter with the endangered Rothschild giraffes at the Giraffe Centre, where you can feed and interact with these gentle giants. The day concludes with a visit to a local craft market or modern mall, giving you the chance to shop for authentic Kenyan souvenirs.

This one-day excursion is ideal for those seeking a compact yet enriching safari experience, blending wildlife, culture, and city life seamlessly.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Best of Nairobi City Excursion

Enjoy incredible sightings of lions, rhinos, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, and more, all set against the unique backdrop of Nairobi’s skyline. Early morning offers the best opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography, making this a highlight of your Nairobi tour.

11:00 AM – 12:00 PM: Visit the David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage

Visit the renowned elephant orphanage and watch rescued baby elephants during their feeding and mud-bath session. Learn about elephant conservation efforts and enjoy the opportunity to symbolically adopt an elephant. (Note: Visiting hours are strictly between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM.)

Enjoy a premium dining experience at the iconic Carnivore Restaurant, known for its unique “Beast of a Feast.” Indulge in a wide selection of expertly prepared meats, with vegetarian options available upon request, ensuring a satisfying experience for all travelers.

2:30 PM – 3:30 PM: Visit the Giraffe Centre

Get up close with endangered Rothschild giraffes at the Giraffe Centre. Feed them from a raised platform, capture memorable photos, and learn about conservation initiatives dedicated to protecting these magnificent animals.

4:00 PM – 5:30 PM: Shopping Experience at Craft Market or Mall

Explore Nairobi’s local shopping scene and choose between authentic handmade crafts or modern retail experiences. Visit Kazuri Beads or Utamaduni Craft Centre for unique souvenirs, jewelry, and traditional items, or head to Galleria Mall for a more contemporary shopping experience.

6:00 PM – Drop-Off at Hotel/Residence

End your day with a comfortable transfer back to your hotel or residence, filled with unforgettable memories of Nairobi’s wildlife, culture, and vibrant city life.

title: Off-the-Beaten-Path North & East (12 Days)
overview:
Discover the hidden beauty of Sri Lanka on this North East Sri Lanka Tour, a 12-day luxury journey through the island’s most untouched regions. This carefully designed itinerary blends wildlife, culture, beaches, and authentic local experiences.

Your journey begins in Negombo, where you can relax by the coast and ease into island life. From here, travel to Wilpattu National Park. Here, you will enjoy exciting safaris and the chance to spot leopards, sloth bears, and exotic birds.

Next, continue north to Jaffna. This region offers a unique cultural experience unlike anywhere else in Sri Lanka. You will explore ancient temples, colonial forts, and remote islands. In addition, you will discover traditions shaped by history and resilience.

Afterward, travel to the east coast. Trincomalee and Nilaveli welcome you with pristine beaches and calm turquoise waters. Here, you can relax, unwind, and enjoy the tropical setting. Moreover, a snorkeling trip to Pigeon Island reveals colorful coral reefs, tropical fish, and even reef sharks.

The journey then takes you inland to Gal Oya National Park. This is one of Sri Lanka’s most exclusive eco-tourism destinations. During your stay, enjoy a rare boat safari where elephants can be seen swimming between islands. Furthermore, you will meet the indigenous Veddah community and learn about their traditional way of life.

Finally, your tour ends in Colombo. Here, you will explore a vibrant city filled with history, culture, and modern energy. From temples to markets and oceanfront views, Colombo offers the perfect ending to your journey.

Throughout this North East Sri Lanka Tour, you will enjoy luxury accommodation, private transport, and personalized service. As a result, your experience will be seamless, comfortable, and truly memorable.

This tour is ideal for travelers who want something different. It combines nature, culture, and beach relaxation in one refined and unforgettable journey.

itinerary.title: Day 1: – Arrival in Sri Lanka & Transfer to Negombo
itinerary.body: Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur and transferred to Negombo, a charming coastal town known for its colonial heritage and relaxed atmosphere. Begin your journey with a scenic boat ride along the historic Hamilton Canal, originally built during the Dutch colonial era. Later, visit the iconic St. Mary’s Church, admired for its striking neoclassical architecture and beautifully painted ceiling. In the evening, take a leisurely stroll along Negombo Beach, where golden sands and swaying palms set the tone for your luxury escape. Enjoy a relaxing overnight stay in Negombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2: – Negombo to Wilpattu National Park Safari Experience
itinerary.body: After breakfast, journey դեպի Wilpattu National Park, Sri Lanka’s largest and oldest national park, renowned for its unique “Willu” lakes and rich biodiversity. Check into your lodge before embarking on an exciting afternoon jeep safari. As you traverse through dense forests and open plains, keep an eye out for leopards, sloth bears, spotted deer, crocodiles, and an array of birdlife. The park’s untouched wilderness offers an authentic and less crowded safari experience. Return to your lodge for a peaceful overnight stay surrounded by nature.

itinerary.title: Day 3: – Morning Safari & Journey to Jaffna
itinerary.body: Start your day with an early morning safari, when wildlife activity is at its peak. After breakfast, travel north towards Jaffna, the cultural heart of Sri Lanka’s Northern Province. Upon arrival, explore the magnificent Nallur Kandaswamy Temple, one of the most significant Hindu temples in the country, known for its vibrant architecture and spiritual ambiance. Continue to Jaffna Fort, a colonial-era stronghold with panoramic views of the lagoon. Visit the Jaffna Public Library, a symbol of knowledge and resilience, and the Archaeological Museum showcasing artifacts from ancient civilizations. Overnight stay in Jaffna.

itinerary.title: Day 4: – Jaffna Peninsula & Island Exploration
itinerary.body: Today is dedicated to discovering the unique landscapes and cultural heritage of the Jaffna Peninsula. Visit the mysterious Nilavarai Bottomless Well, steeped in local legend. Continue with an excursion to Delft Island, famous for its wild horses, coral walls, and serene isolation. Later, visit Nainativu Island, an important religious site for both Hindu and Buddhist pilgrims. These island experiences offer a rare glimpse into Sri Lanka’s diverse cultural tapestry. Return to Jaffna for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 5: – Jaffna to Trincomalee via Kanniya Hot Springs
itinerary.body: After breakfast, embark on a scenic drive to Trincomalee on the east coast. En route, visit the Kanniya Hot Springs, a cluster of ancient wells with varying temperatures, believed to have therapeutic properties. Continue your journey to the coastal paradise of Nilaveli, where pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters await. Check into your beachside resort and spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the tranquil ambiance of Sri Lanka’s east coast. Overnight stay in Trincomalee/Nilaveli.

itinerary.title: Day 6: – Trincomalee Cultural Highlights & Scenic Coastline
itinerary.body: Explore the cultural and historical highlights of Trincomalee today. Visit the colorful Pathirakali Amman Temple, adorned with intricate sculptures and vibrant carvings. Proceed to Fort Frederick, a historic colonial fort surrounded by lush greenery and roaming deer. Within the fort lies the sacred Koneswaram Temple, perched dramatically on a cliff overlooking the Indian Ocean, offering breathtaking panoramic views. Spend the rest of the day relaxing by the beach or enjoying your resort facilities. Overnight stay in Trincomalee.

itinerary.title: Day 7: – Snorkeling Adventure at Pigeon Island National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, embark on a marine adventure to Pigeon Island National Park, one of Sri Lanka’s finest snorkeling destinations. Discover vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life, including tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks. The crystal-clear waters provide excellent visibility, making this an unforgettable experience for both beginners and experienced snorkelers. Return to your hotel and spend the evening at leisure by the beach. Overnight stay in Trincomalee.

itinerary.title: Day 8: – Leisure Day at Nilaveli Beach
itinerary.body: Enjoy a full day of relaxation at Nilaveli Beach, widely regarded as one of the most beautiful beaches in Sri Lanka. You may choose to unwind by the ocean, indulge in spa treatments, or take a gentle hike up Diamond Hill for sweeping coastal views. This day is designed for pure relaxation and rejuvenation in a serene tropical setting. Overnight stay in Trincomalee.

itinerary.title: Day 9: – Trincomalee to Gal Oya National Park
itinerary.body: After breakfast, travel դեպի Gal Oya, one of Sri Lanka’s most untouched eco-tourism destinations. Upon arrival, immerse yourself in nature with a unique boat safari on Senanayake Samudra, the country’s largest reservoir. This rare experience offers the chance to witness elephants swimming between islands, along with diverse birdlife and other wildlife. Later, explore the Nilgala section on a jeep safari, known for its savannah-like landscape and rich biodiversity. Overnight stay at an eco-lodge in Gal Oya.

itinerary.title: Day 10: – Veddah Cultural Experience & Transfer to Colombo
itinerary.body: Begin your day with a truly authentic cultural experience by visiting the indigenous Veddah community. Walk through the forest with local guides and learn about their traditional lifestyle, hunting techniques, and deep connection to nature. After this immersive experience, journey դեպի Colombo, Sri Lanka’s vibrant commercial capital. Check into your hotel and relax for the evening. Overnight stay in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 11: – Colombo City Exploration by Tuk Tuk
itinerary.body: Discover Colombo’s dynamic blend of old and new on a guided tuk tuk city tour. Visit the iconic Lotus Tower, offering panoramic views of the city skyline. Explore the historic Gangaramaya Temple and the serene Seema Malaka floating temple. Continue to the National Museum for insights into Sri Lanka’s rich heritage. Admire the striking architecture of the Jami Ul Alfar Mosque (Red Mosque) and conclude your day with a relaxing walk along Galle Face Green, overlooking the Indian Ocean. Overnight stay in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 12: – Departure from Colombo
itinerary.body: After breakfast, enjoy some last-minute shopping or relaxation depending on your flight schedule. You will then be transferred to the airport for your departure, bringing your unforgettable North & East Sri Lanka luxury journey to a close.

This itinerary is ideal for first-time visitors, couples, families, and private travelers looking for a balanced mix of heritage, nature, adventure, and relaxation.

Your journey begins on the west coast in Negombo, before moving into the heart of Sri Lanka’s ancient civilization with visits to Anuradhapura, Sigiriya, Dambulla, and Polonnaruwa. These historic destinations showcase UNESCO World Heritage Sites, sacred temples, ancient cities, and some of the most impressive ruins in South Asia.

The route then continues into the central highlands, where Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, and Ella reveal a different side of Sri Lanka. Here, travelers can enjoy sacred temples, botanical gardens, rolling tea estates, waterfalls, cool mountain air, and one of the world’s most scenic train journeys from Nanu Oya to Ella. The hill country section also includes Horton Plains National Park, home to the famous World’s End viewpoint.

From the mountains, the tour descends into Sri Lanka’s wildlife and coastal regions. Enjoy an exciting safari in Udawalawe National Park, well known for elephant sightings, before exploring the colonial beauty of Galle Fort and relaxing on the southern beaches of Mirissa or Unawatuna. Seasonal whale watching can also be added for an unforgettable marine experience.

This 14-day Sri Lanka round tour offers a complete island experience, combining history, spirituality, tea country landscapes, safari, beaches, and local culture in one seamless route.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Negombo Coastal Stay
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide and transferred to Negombo, a charming coastal town located just a short drive from the airport. This relaxed first day is designed to help you settle into Sri Lanka gently while enjoying a seaside atmosphere before the island loop begins in full.

In the evening, enjoy a leisurely walk along Negombo Beach, where fishing boats, golden sand, and the Indian Ocean create a calm tropical setting. Negombo is also known for its seafood culture, so this is a wonderful place to enjoy a fresh local dinner at a traditional Sri Lankan seafood restaurant. The coastal setting offers a soft and enjoyable start to your Sri Lanka island journey.

Overnight stay in Negombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Negombo to Anuradhapura – Ancient Kingdom Heritage
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, travel north to Anuradhapura, one of Sri Lanka’s most important UNESCO World Heritage Sites and the first great capital of the island. This sacred city is filled with ancient stupas, monasteries, reservoirs, royal ruins, and centuries of Buddhist heritage. It is one of the most historically significant destinations in Sri Lanka and offers deep insight into the island’s early civilization.

Explore the vast archaeological zone, where you may see monumental dagobas, ancient ceremonial bathing pools, and the revered Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi, believed to be the oldest historically documented tree planted by human hands. The wide layout of the city makes it ideal for a full sightseeing day, and the atmosphere here is both spiritual and monumental. This day introduces the cultural depth that defines the first phase of the itinerary.

Overnight stay in the Anuradhapura / Cultural Triangle region.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Anuradhapura to Sigiriya – Dambulla and Minneriya Safari
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue to the Sigiriya region in the heart of Sri Lanka’s Cultural Triangle. En route or after arrival, visit the magnificent Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its ancient cave shrines, murals, and large collection of Buddha statues. This is one of the most impressive temple complexes in Sri Lanka and an essential stop for cultural travelers.

Later in the day, enjoy a safari experience in Minneriya National Park, famous for elephant sightings and especially known for “The Gathering,” when large numbers of wild elephants can often be seen around the reservoir area. This safari adds a beautiful wildlife element to the cultural route and creates a strong contrast between Sri Lanka’s ancient heritage and natural biodiversity.

Overnight stay in Sigiriya / Habarana.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Sigiriya – Lion Rock and Pidurangala
itinerary.body:
Wake early for a sunrise climb of the world-famous Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, one of Sri Lanka’s most iconic landmarks and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Rising dramatically above the plains, this ancient rock citadel was built in the 5th century and is known for its royal gardens, frescoes, mirror wall, lion paws, and summit ruins. An early start allows you to enjoy cooler weather and better light for views and photography.

Later in the day, you may visit or hike Pidurangala Rock, which provides one of the best panoramic viewpoints in the region and a striking perspective of Sigiriya Rock itself. The combination of Sigiriya and Pidurangala makes this one of the most visually rewarding days of the itinerary. It offers a perfect blend of history, landscape, and adventure in the Cultural Triangle.

Overnight stay in Sigiriya / Habarana.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Sigiriya to Polonnaruwa – Medieval Capital Experience
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to exploring Polonnaruwa, another UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Sri Lanka’s best-preserved ancient capitals. Compared to Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa is more compact and easier to navigate, yet equally rich in history and architectural importance. This medieval city is known for its royal ruins, stone temples, audience halls, and ancient reservoirs.

One of the major highlights is the Gal Vihara, where giant Buddha statues have been carved from a single granite rock face in an extraordinary display of craftsmanship and devotion. The city offers a fascinating continuation of Sri Lanka’s historical story, allowing travelers to appreciate the scale and sophistication of its former kingdoms.

Overnight stay in the Cultural Triangle region.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Polonnaruwa / Sigiriya to Kandy – Temple and Spice Route
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, travel south to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s cultural capital and one of the island’s most important spiritual centers. On the way, a stop at a spice garden in Matale offers insight into Sri Lanka’s historic spice trade and local herbal traditions. The route gradually changes from the dry-zone plains of the Cultural Triangle to the greener and cooler landscapes of the central hills.

In the evening, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic during the pooja ceremony, one of the most sacred Buddhist rituals in Sri Lanka. This experience offers a meaningful spiritual dimension to the journey. Later, enjoy the atmosphere around Kandy, a city framed by hills, heritage, and lake views.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Kandy – Botanical Gardens and Cultural Atmosphere
itinerary.body:
Spend the day enjoying Kandy and its surroundings at a relaxed pace. Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, one of the most celebrated gardens in Asia, known for its orchid collections, giant trees, tropical flora, and landscaped pathways. This is one of the most beautiful garden experiences in Sri Lanka and a highlight for nature lovers.

Later, enjoy a walk around Kandy Lake or watch a traditional Kandyan dance performance in the evening. This day gives the journey some breathing space in one of Sri Lanka’s most charming and historic cities before continuing into the cooler tea country.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya – Tea Country and Colonial Charm
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue into the scenic highlands of Nuwara Eliya, often called “Little England” because of its cool climate and colonial-era atmosphere. En route, visit a working tea factory such as Pedro or Damro, where you can see how world-famous Ceylon tea is processed and prepared. Walk through the tea bushes and enjoy the misty beauty of Sri Lanka’s plantation landscapes.

On arrival in Nuwara Eliya, enjoy the elegant hill-country setting, perhaps with a traditional high tea experience at one of the town’s historic hotels. This day marks the start of the highland phase of the tour, where tea, scenery, cool weather, and colonial architecture define the experience.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Nuwara Eliya – Horton Plains and World’s End
itinerary.body:
Start early for Horton Plains National Park, one of Sri Lanka’s most unique highland landscapes. This protected plateau is famous for its cloud forest environment, grasslands, cool climate, and the dramatic viewpoint known as World’s End, a steep escarpment with a breathtaking drop. The hiking trail through Horton Plains is one of the island’s best nature walks and is especially rewarding in the early morning before mist covers the views.

This day adds a strong nature and soft-adventure element to the hill country section of the itinerary. The walk is scenic and memorable, and the shift from tea estate towns to wild montane landscapes creates another beautiful contrast within the island loop.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Nanu Oya to Ella – Scenic Train Ride
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, transfer to Nanu Oya Railway Station and board the scenic train to Ella. This segment is widely considered one of the most beautiful train journeys in Sri Lanka, offering views of mountains, tea plantations, forests, bridges, and valley landscapes. It is a must-do experience for travelers exploring the central highlands.

Upon arrival in Ella, enjoy the town’s relaxed atmosphere, café culture, and beautiful natural surroundings. The evening is ideal for unwinding after the train journey and taking in the mountain-town vibe that makes Ella one of Sri Lanka’s most loved destinations.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 11: Ella – Peaks and Bridges
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to Ella’s most iconic attractions. Start with a hike to Little Adam’s Peak, a rewarding and relatively easy climb that offers panoramic views of the Ella Gap and the surrounding hill country. Later, visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most photographed landmarks and a remarkable piece of colonial-era railway engineering.

This day is ideal for travelers who enjoy scenic viewpoints, easy hiking, and photography. Ella’s combination of lush landscapes, cool air, and visual drama makes it one of the strongest highlights of the tour.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 12: Ella to Udawalawe – Elephant Country
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, descend from the hill country to Udawalawe National Park, one of Sri Lanka’s most rewarding safari destinations. This park is especially well known for its large elephant population and open landscapes, making wildlife sightings easier and more consistent than in many other parks.

In the afternoon, enjoy a jeep safari in Udawalawe and, if included in your final route, visit the Elephant Transit Home, where orphaned elephant calves are cared for before release into the wild. This day adds a powerful wildlife dimension to the tour and creates a memorable shift from misty mountains to the dry-zone plains of southern Sri Lanka.

Overnight stay in Udawalawe.

itinerary.title: Day 13: Udawalawe to Galle – Colonial Coastline
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue to Sri Lanka’s southern coast and enter the walled city of Galle Fort, one of the island’s most treasured UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Galle Fort blends colonial architecture, sea views, stylish boutiques, and old-world atmosphere in a way that feels both historic and alive.

Spend the day walking along the fort ramparts, visiting the lighthouse, and exploring the boutique shops, cafés, and galleries hidden within the Dutch-colonial streets. Sunset at Galle Fort is one of the most beautiful coastal experiences in Sri Lanka and offers a refined ending to the safari-and-highlands section of the itinerary.

Overnight stay in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 14: Southern Coast to Colombo Airport – Beach and Departure
itinerary.body:
On your final day, enjoy a last beach morning in the south, either in Mirissa or Unawatuna depending on your preferred departure setup. If traveling between November and April, whale watching in Mirissa can be arranged as an optional final experience. Otherwise, the day can be spent simply enjoying the coastline before the journey back to the airport.

Later, travel via the Southern Expressway towards Colombo Airport for departure, marking the end of your Sri Lanka Island Loop Tour — a complete journey through ancient cities, tea country, scenic rail, wildlife, beaches, and heritage coastlines.

title: Sri Lanka Wildlife Safari Experience
overview:
Experience the untamed beauty of the island with this 5 Nights / 6 Days Sri Lanka Wildlife Safari, a carefully curated journey designed for nature lovers, wildlife enthusiasts, and adventure seekers. This immersive safari tour takes you through some of the most biodiverse and iconic ecosystems in Sri Lanka, combining lush rainforests, open savannah landscapes, and coastal wetlands into one unforgettable experience.

Your adventure begins in the world-renowned Sinharaja Forest Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the last remaining primary tropical rainforest in Sri Lanka. Here, you will explore dense jungle trails rich in endemic wildlife, including rare birds, reptiles, and unique plant species found nowhere else on Earth. This is one of the best locations in Sri Lanka for eco-tourism and birdwatching.

The journey continues to Udawalawe National Park, one of the top destinations in Asia to see wild elephants in their natural habitat. Enjoy an exciting jeep safari across vast grasslands and visit the Elephant Transit Home, where orphaned elephant calves are rehabilitated before returning to the wild.

Next, explore the legendary Yala National Park, famous for having one of the highest leopard densities in the world. This thrilling safari experience offers the chance to spot leopards, sloth bears, elephants, crocodiles, and a wide variety of birdlife.

The tour also includes a visit to Bundala National Park, a globally recognized wetland sanctuary known for its migratory birds, including flamingos, and concludes with a relaxing coastal experience at the historic Galle Dutch Fort, a UNESCO-listed heritage site blending colonial charm with ocean views.

This Sri Lanka wildlife safari package perfectly balances adventure, conservation, and scenic beauty, making it ideal for travelers seeking an authentic and unforgettable nature experience in Sri Lanka.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Journey to Sinharaja Rainforest
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival in Sri Lanka, you will be warmly welcomed by your private driver-guide and begin your journey south towards the legendary Sinharaja Forest Reserve, one of the island’s most important ecological treasures. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Sinharaja is the country’s last viable area of primary tropical rainforest and one of the best places in Sri Lanka for nature lovers, birdwatchers, and wildlife enthusiasts.

As you travel towards this lush rainforest region, the scenery gradually changes into dense greenery and misty forest landscapes. On arrival, check in to your eco-friendly accommodation and enjoy the peaceful surroundings of the jungle. The evening is ideal for relaxation while listening to the natural sounds of the rainforest and preparing for the adventure ahead. This first day sets the tone for a unique Sri Lanka wildlife safari filled with biodiversity, scenic beauty, and unforgettable nature experiences.

Overnight stay in Sinharaja.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Full-Day Exploration of Sinharaja Forest Reserve
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to discovering the exceptional biodiversity of Sinharaja Forest Reserve, one of Sri Lanka’s most valuable natural habitats. Accompanied by an experienced local guide, you will explore rainforest trails rich in endemic flora and fauna that exist nowhere else on Earth. Sinharaja is especially famous for birdwatching, and this is one of the best places to spot rare endemic species such as the Sri Lanka Blue Magpie, Red-faced Malkoha, Green-billed Coucal, and other rainforest birds.

As you trek deeper into the forest, you may also encounter rare amphibians, reptiles, colorful butterflies, unique insects, and small mammals hidden within the dense canopy. The reserve’s rich ecosystem makes it one of the top eco-tourism destinations in Sri Lanka. Along the trail, you may also come across cascading streams and hidden waterfalls, which add to the magical atmosphere of this ancient rainforest.

This is a truly immersive day for travelers who appreciate raw nature, biodiversity, and off-the-beaten-path experiences in Sri Lanka. After a rewarding day of exploration, return to your eco-lodge and relax in the tranquility of the rainforest.

Overnight stay in Sinharaja.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Sinharaja – Udawalawe National Park
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, leave the rainforest behind and travel towards Udawalawe National Park, one of the best places in Asia to see wild elephants in their natural habitat. The landscape changes dramatically from dense tropical forest to open dry-zone plains, creating a striking contrast in scenery and wildlife experience.

Before entering the park area, visit the Elephant Transit Home, where orphaned elephant calves are cared for before being reintroduced into the wild. This is an inspiring conservation stop that offers insight into Sri Lanka’s efforts to protect and rehabilitate elephants.

Later, enjoy an exciting afternoon jeep safari in Udawalawe National Park. This park is particularly famous for its large elephant population, and sightings are frequent. In addition to elephants, you may also see water buffalo, spotted deer, jackals, crocodiles, monkeys, and a wide range of bird species including eagles and other birds of prey. The open grasslands and scenic reservoir make Udawalawe one of Sri Lanka’s most accessible and rewarding wildlife parks.

After the safari, continue to your accommodation and unwind after a day filled with conservation insights and memorable elephant encounters.

Overnight stay in the Udawalawe / Yala region.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Udawalawe – Yala National Park Safari
itinerary.body:
Today you continue your Sri Lanka safari adventure towards Yala National Park, the island’s most famous wildlife destination and one of the best places in the world to spot the elusive Sri Lankan leopard. Yala is known for its varied landscapes of scrub jungle, lagoons, grasslands, and rocky outcrops, creating an ideal habitat for a wide range of mammals, reptiles, and birdlife.

In the late afternoon, embark on a thrilling jeep safari in Yala National Park. This is the golden hour for wildlife viewing, when animals become more active and the light is perfect for photography. Keep an eye out for leopards, sloth bears, elephants, crocodiles, wild boar, deer, and peacocks. Yala’s reputation for leopard sightings makes it one of the top safari parks in South Asia and a major highlight of any Sri Lanka wildlife tour.

The safari offers a dramatic and exciting contrast to the rainforest experience of Sinharaja and the elephant plains of Udawalawe. After the safari, proceed to your hotel and enjoy a restful evening surrounded by the rugged landscapes of the southeast.

Overnight stay in Yala.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Bundala National Park – Galle Dutch Fort
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue towards Bundala National Park, an internationally important wetland sanctuary and one of Sri Lanka’s best birdwatching destinations. Bundala is especially known for its lagoons, marshes, and migratory birdlife. During your morning safari or bird-focused visit, look out for greater flamingos, storks, pelicans, ibis, and other water birds that thrive in this rich wetland ecosystem.

Bundala adds a new dimension to your Sri Lanka wildlife safari by introducing coastal wetlands and birdlife rather than large mammals alone. The blend of lagoons, salt pans, dunes, and marsh habitats creates a peaceful yet fascinating nature experience.

Later, continue your journey to the historic Galle Dutch Fort, where the pace of the trip shifts from wildlife to heritage and coastal charm. Walk through the cobbled streets and ramparts of this famous UNESCO-listed fort city and enjoy the blend of colonial architecture, ocean views, boutique cafes, and timeless atmosphere. Sunset at Galle Fort is one of the most beautiful coastal experiences in Sri Lanka and offers a perfect ending to the day.

Overnight stay in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Galle / Coast – Colombo – Departure
itinerary.body:
On your final day, begin the journey back towards Colombo and the airport. Depending on your departure time, you may enjoy a scenic coastal drive along Sri Lanka’s southern shoreline, taking in the last views of the Indian Ocean and local seaside towns. If time permits, a brief stop in Colombo for souvenir shopping or a short city orientation can be arranged before airport transfer.

This final transfer marks the end of your Sri Lanka wildlife safari, a journey that combines rainforest biodiversity, elephant encounters, leopard territory, wetland birdlife, and coastal heritage into one unforgettable experience. You leave the island with lasting memories of Sri Lanka’s natural beauty, unique wildlife, and diverse landscapes.

Transfer to Colombo Airport for departure.

title: The Classic Highlights
overview:
Discover the best of the island with this carefully crafted 7 Nights / 8 Days Sri Lanka Classic Highlights Tour, a complete journey through Sri Lanka’s cultural heritage, scenic hill country, iconic train routes, tropical beaches, wildlife experiences, and vibrant capital city. This itinerary is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the most famous places in Sri Lanka in one seamless and unforgettable holiday.

Your journey begins in Negombo, a charming coastal town known for its fishing traditions, canals, and golden beaches. Continue inland to Sigiriya, where you can experience village life, rural landscapes, and one of Sri Lanka’s most celebrated UNESCO World Heritage Sites, the majestic Sigiriya Lion Rock. Explore the remarkable Dambulla Cave Temple, then continue to Kandy, Sri Lanka’s cultural capital, home to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, scenic Kandy Lake, and a vibrant cultural dance performance.

From Kandy, enjoy the world-famous scenic train ride to Ella, one of the most beautiful rail journeys in Sri Lanka, passing tea estates, tunnels, waterfalls, and dramatic mountain scenery. In Ella, discover iconic attractions such as Ella Rock, Nine Arch Bridge, and Flying Ravana, before heading south to the coast.

Your beach and coastal highlights include Mirissa, known for beautiful viewpoints and seasonal whale watching, Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site rich in colonial history, and Bentota, where you can visit a turtle hatchery and enjoy a relaxing coastal atmosphere. The tour ends with a Colombo city tour, featuring Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, the Red Mosque, and shopping before airport departure.

This Sri Lanka tour package is perfect for travelers seeking a balanced mix of culture, nature, beaches, train journeys, and iconic sightseeing in one classic route.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Colombo Airport – Negombo
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Colombo Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private driver-guide and transferred to Negombo, one of Sri Lanka’s most popular coastal towns. This relaxed seaside destination is known for its fishing heritage, canals, and beautiful beach atmosphere, making it a gentle and enjoyable start to your Sri Lanka holiday.

Begin your sightseeing with a visit to the famous Negombo Fish Market, where you can observe local fishermen bringing in their daily catch and see a vibrant display of Sri Lanka’s coastal lifestyle. Continue with a visit to the historic Hamilton Canal, also known as the Dutch Canal, which once served as an important trade and supply route during the colonial period. If available, a boat ride or canal-side experience can offer a peaceful introduction to the area.

Later, enjoy time at Negombo Beach, where you can relax by the ocean, enjoy the sea breeze, and settle into the laid-back atmosphere of Sri Lanka’s west coast. This first day is designed to help you unwind after arrival while offering a glimpse into the island’s coastal culture.

Overnight stay in Negombo.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Negombo – Pinnawala Area / Sigiriya Experience
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, depart for Sri Lanka’s cultural triangle region and travel towards Sigiriya. This day focuses on rural experiences and authentic village life. One of the highlights is the Sigiriya Village Tour, which offers a memorable introduction to the countryside of Sri Lanka. During this experience, you can enjoy views of paddy fields, a traditional bullock cart ride, a catamaran ride across a village lake, and a closer look at local agriculture and village cooking traditions.

A traditional Sri Lankan lunch is part of the village experience, giving travelers a taste of authentic local cuisine in a rural setting. Depending on your final package setup, additional countryside experiences may be included along the way. This day provides a softer, more immersive contrast to the historic sites that follow and is especially appealing to travelers who want to experience everyday Sri Lankan life beyond standard sightseeing.

Overnight stay in Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Sigiriya – Dambulla – Kandy
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, climb the world-famous Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, one of Sri Lanka’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Built in the 5th century, this ancient rock citadel rises dramatically above the surrounding plains and offers a fascinating combination of history, architecture, royal gardens, and panoramic views. As you ascend, you will pass impressive rock features, ancient frescoes, and the famous lion’s paws before reaching the summit.

Continue to the Dambulla Cave Temple, another UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most impressive cave temple complexes in Sri Lanka. The caves are filled with remarkable Buddhist statues, ancient murals, and centuries of spiritual history. From Dambulla, proceed to Matale for a spice garden visit, where you can learn about Sri Lanka’s famous spices such as cinnamon, pepper, cardamom, and nutmeg.

Arrive in Kandy and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of the most sacred Buddhist sites in Sri Lanka. Afterwards, enjoy the beauty of Kandy Lake and in the evening attend the Kandy Cultural Dance Show, a lively performance of traditional Sri Lankan dance and drumming. This day combines heritage, spirituality, and culture in one of Sri Lanka’s most important cities.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Kandy – Scenic Train Ride to Ella
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, board the scenic train from Kandy to Ella, one of the most famous train journeys in Sri Lanka and often considered one of the most beautiful rail experiences in the world. The full ride can take several hours, but the changing scenery makes it one of the most unforgettable parts of the trip.

As the train climbs into the cooler hill country, you will pass tea plantations, valleys, tunnels, mountain slopes, and dramatic viewpoints. The stretch between Nanu Oya and Ella is particularly famous for its iconic views and photographic opportunities. Along the way, stations such as Hatton and Haputale provide some of the finest scenery in Sri Lanka’s central highlands.

Upon arrival in Ella, check in and enjoy the relaxed mountain-town atmosphere. Ella is one of Sri Lanka’s most loved hill country destinations, known for its views, cool climate, and easy access to nature-based attractions.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Ella Sightseeing Experience
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to exploring the beautiful surroundings of Ella. Start with a visit or hike to Ella Rock, one of the region’s most rewarding viewpoints, offering sweeping views of Sri Lanka’s highlands, valleys, and green mountains. Ella is especially popular with nature lovers and photographers, and this area offers some of the best scenery in the country.

Continue to the famous Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most photographed landmarks and one of the best examples of colonial-era railway engineering. Surrounded by dense greenery and hill country scenery, this bridge is a must-visit attraction in Ella. You may also visit Ravana Cave depending on timing and interest.

For travelers seeking a more adventurous activity, Flying Ravana is available near Little Adam’s Peak and offers a thrilling zip-line experience across the lush green landscape. Whether you choose adventure, sightseeing, or simply relaxation with mountain views, Ella is a major highlight of this classic Sri Lanka route.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Ella – Mirissa
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, descend from the cool hill country to Sri Lanka’s southern coast and travel to Mirissa, one of the island’s most beautiful beach destinations. On arrival, visit Coconut Tree Hill, a famous viewpoint framed by palm trees and panoramic ocean views. This spot has become one of the most photographed places on the south coast, especially at sunset.

You can also visit Parrot Rock, a small rocky outcrop that offers beautiful views over Mirissa Beach and the surrounding coastline. The beach atmosphere in Mirissa is lively yet relaxing, making it a perfect place to unwind after the mountain segment of the tour. The transition from cool hill country to tropical beach scenery makes this day especially memorable.

Overnight stay in Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Mirissa – Galle – Bentota
itinerary.body:
Start early if you choose to join a whale and dolphin watching excursion in Mirissa, one of the most popular marine experiences in Sri Lanka. The season generally runs from November to April, and sightings may include blue whales, dolphins, and other marine life depending on conditions.

Later, continue to Galle Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site on the southern coast. Explore the charming cobbled streets, colonial architecture, lighthouse, and sea-facing ramparts of this historic fort city. Galle offers a unique mix of history, shopping, cafes, and ocean views, making it one of Sri Lanka’s most elegant coastal attractions.

Proceed to Bentota and visit a Turtle Hatchery, where sea turtles are protected and rehabilitated. This experience adds an educational and conservation element to the coastal section of your journey. Afterward, continue to your accommodation in Bentota for a relaxing evening by the beach.

Overnight stay in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Colombo City Tour – Airport Departure
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, proceed to Colombo for a city tour of Sri Lanka’s commercial capital. Visit key landmarks including Gangaramaya Temple, Seema Malakaya, and Beira Lake. Continue to Independence Square, a significant national monument, and visit the famous Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque, also known as the Red Mosque, known for its striking red-and-white architecture.

Depending on your flight timing, enjoy some shopping in Colombo before heading to the airport. This final day offers a lively contrast to the rest of the journey, combining heritage, modern city life, and last-minute souvenir shopping before departure.

Transfer to Colombo Airport for your onward flight.

title: 8-Day Masai Mara, Amboseli, All-Inclusive Kenya Safari
overview:
Discover the very best of Kenya with our 8-Day All-Inclusive Kenya Safari, an immersive journey through the country’s most iconic wildlife destinations and breathtaking landscapes. This carefully curated safari combines Amboseli National Park, Lake Naivasha, Hell’s Gate National Park, Lake Nakuru National Park, and the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve, offering a complete and unforgettable African experience.

Your adventure begins in Amboseli National Park, famous for its large elephant herds and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Enjoy thrilling game drives across diverse landscapes, where elephants, lions, cheetahs, giraffes, and abundant birdlife roam freely. The dramatic scenery and open plains make Amboseli one of Kenya’s most photogenic safari destinations.

Next, travel through the scenic Great Rift Valley to Lake Naivasha, a tranquil freshwater lake surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant birdlife. A relaxing boat safari allows you to observe hippos and water birds up close, followed by a unique walking safari experience in the nearby sanctuary.

Continue to Hell’s Gate National Park, one of the few parks in Kenya where you can explore on foot or by bicycle, surrounded by towering cliffs and geothermal landscapes. From here, proceed to Lake Nakuru National Park, a renowned sanctuary famous for its rhino population and flamingo-filled shores.

The highlight of your safari awaits in the legendary Masai Mara National Reserve, one of Africa’s greatest wildlife destinations. Spend multiple days exploring vast savannah plains in search of the Big Five and witnessing extraordinary wildlife interactions. During migration season, experience the dramatic river crossings of wildebeest and zebras.

With all accommodations, meals, park fees, and guided experiences included, this safari offers a seamless blend of luxury, adventure, and authentic African discovery.

Arrive in the afternoon in time for lunch. Later, enjoy a boat ride on Lake Naivasha where you can spot hippos and birdlife, followed by a walking safari in a nearby sanctuary where giraffes, zebras, and other wildlife can be seen up close.

Transfer to Lake Nakuru

itinerary.title: Day 5: Lake Nakuru to Masai Mara National Reserve
itinerary.body:

After breakfast, head out for a game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park, renowned for its large populations of black and white rhinos, as well as lions, giraffes, zebras, and rich birdlife.

Transfer to Masai Mara

Continue your journey to the world-famous Masai Mara National Reserve. Arrive and settle into your lodge or camp.

Spend two days exploring the Masai Mara with full-day game drives and picnic lunches. Visit the Mara River, a key highlight during the Great Migration season, and enjoy exceptional wildlife viewing opportunities throughout the reserve.

The Masai Mara is home to the Big Five and offers some of the most rewarding safari experiences in Africa, with vast open landscapes and abundant wildlife.

You will be transferred to your Nairobi hotel, residence, or airport, marking the end of your memorable Kenya safari adventure.
