title: Best of Both Sri Lanka Tour
overview:
Discover the island’s most iconic experiences with this Best of Both Sri Lanka Tour, a carefully designed 10-day journey that blends culture, hill country scenery, wildlife, beaches, and city highlights into one unforgettable holiday. This route is ideal for travelers who want to experience the true diversity of Sri Lanka in a single premium itinerary.

Your journey begins in Kandy, Sri Lanka’s cultural capital, with visits to the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, scenic Kandy Lake, a traditional cultural dance performance, and the green slopes of the Hanthana mountain range. The tour then moves into the cool highlands of Nuwara Eliya, where tea plantations, waterfalls, botanical gardens, colonial charm, and Gregory Lake create a classic hill country experience.

One of the biggest highlights of the trip is the scenic Nanu Oya to Ella train ride, widely known as one of the most beautiful rail journeys in Sri Lanka. In Ella, enjoy iconic attractions such as Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam’s Peak, before continuing to Yala National Park for an exciting wildlife safari with chances to spot elephants, leopards, and other native wildlife.

From there, the journey flows to the southern coast with time in Mirissa, famous for coconut-lined viewpoints and seasonal whale watching, then to historic Galle Fort, one of Sri Lanka’s most treasured UNESCO landmarks. The experience ends in Colombo, where a city tour introduces temples, lakes, colonial-era sites, shopping, and urban energy.

This Sri Lanka travel package is perfect for couples, families, and first-time visitors looking for a complete route that combines the island’s best cultural, scenic, wildlife, and coastal experiences.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Transfer to Kandy
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide and begin your journey towards Kandy, Sri Lanka’s cultural capital. En route, visit the famous Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a well-known conservation center that cares for orphaned and injured elephants. This is a memorable first stop where travelers can observe elephants up close and experience one of Sri Lanka’s most popular family-friendly attractions.

After continuing to Kandy, visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, one of the most important Buddhist temples in Sri Lanka and a major cultural landmark. Later, enjoy a peaceful walk around Kandy Lake, which sits in the heart of the city and adds to Kandy’s charming atmosphere. In the evening, watch a traditional Kandyan Cultural Dance Show, a vibrant introduction to Sri Lanka’s music, costume, rhythm, and heritage. This first day gives travelers a rich cultural welcome to the island.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Kandy – Culture, Nature, and Hill Views
itinerary.body:
Today offers more time to enjoy Kandy and its scenic surroundings. The city is known not only for its sacred heritage but also for its hill country atmosphere and green landscapes. One of the highlights you may enjoy during this stay is the Hanthana Mountain Range area, a popular eco-tourism and viewpoint region southwest of Kandy. The area is known for its scenic ridges, cool air, and panoramic views over the hills and city.

This second day in Kandy gives the journey a more relaxed rhythm, allowing travelers to fully appreciate the balance of spirituality, culture, and landscape before moving deeper into Sri Lanka’s central highlands. Whether spent on city sightseeing, a gentle local exploration, or simply enjoying the atmosphere of the hills, this day strengthens the cultural side of the tour.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya – Gardens, Tea Country, and Waterfalls
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, begin your scenic drive from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya through Sri Lanka’s beautiful central highlands. Start with a visit to the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, one of the most beautiful botanical gardens in Asia, famous for its orchids, tropical plants, and well-kept landscaped grounds.

Continue through the hills with stops at Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple in Ramboda and the beautiful Ramboda Waterfalls. As the journey continues, the scenery becomes increasingly dramatic with tea-covered slopes, cool mountain air, and winding roads. Visit a tea plantation and tea factory to learn how world-famous Ceylon tea is grown, processed, and prepared. By evening, arrive in Nuwara Eliya, often called “Little England,” and enjoy time around Gregory Lake, one of the town’s most popular attractions.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Nuwara Eliya – Hill Country Discovery
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to exploring the elegance and charm of Nuwara Eliya. In addition to the cool climate and colonial-era atmosphere, the town offers a range of scenic and cultural attractions. Visit a local strawberry farm, enjoy the beautiful Hakgala Botanical Garden, and explore the colorful Seetha Amman Temple nearby. These attractions add variety to the classic tea country experience and make the highlands feel both scenic and cultural.

You may also see the historic Nuwara Eliya Post Office, one of the town’s best-known colonial landmarks, admired for its red-brick architecture and old-world charm. This day is ideal for travelers who want to enjoy a softer pace in the highlands, with a blend of viewpoints, gardens, tea landscapes, and classic Sri Lankan hill country heritage.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Nanu Oya to Ella – Scenic Train Journey and Mountain Views
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, transfer to Nanu Oya Railway Station and board the scenic train to Ella, one of the most famous train journeys in Sri Lanka. This iconic ride takes you through tea plantations, valleys, tunnels, mountain ridges, and lush countryside, offering one of the most photogenic travel experiences on the island.

After arriving in Ella, continue with sightseeing in this laid-back hill town known for its views and natural beauty. Visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most photographed landmarks, and enjoy a hike to Little Adam’s Peak, where sweeping views of the surrounding highlands provide a perfect reward. Ella is one of the strongest highlights of this route and gives travelers a beautiful balance of train travel, viewpoints, and nature.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Ella to Yala – Ravana Attractions and Safari Adventure
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, leave Ella and travel towards Yala National Park. En route, visit Ravana Cave and Ravana Falls, both of which are tied to local legend and offer dramatic natural scenery. These stops make the drive south more interesting and scenic before the journey transitions into wildlife territory.

In the afternoon, enjoy a jeep safari in Yala National Park, one of Sri Lanka’s most famous wildlife destinations. Yala is especially known for its leopard population, but the park is also home to elephants, sloth bears, crocodiles, deer, and a wide variety of birds. The safari experience adds an exciting wildlife element to the itinerary and gives travelers the chance to explore a very different side of Sri Lanka compared to the cultural and hill country sections of the tour.

Overnight stay in Yala.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Yala to Mirissa – Wildlife to Coast
itinerary.body:
Begin the day with an early safari or morning in the Yala region before continuing towards Sri Lanka’s southern coast. Travel to Mirissa, one of the island’s most popular beach destinations, known for its tropical coastline, golden sand, and vibrant south coast atmosphere.

On arrival, visit Coconut Tree Hill, one of the most famous viewpoints in Mirissa, framed by palm trees and panoramic sea views. You may also visit Parrot Rock, a small rocky viewpoint overlooking the beach and coastline. This transition from safari landscapes to ocean scenery gives the route its “best of both” character, combining wildlife and beach relaxation in one journey.

Overnight stay in Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Mirissa to Galle – Marine Life and Heritage Coast
itinerary.body:
If traveling in season, you may begin the day with whale and dolphin watching in Mirissa, one of Sri Lanka’s most exciting marine experiences. This optional excursion is especially popular from November to April. Later, continue to Galle, where the focus shifts from marine life and beach scenery to history and heritage.

Visit Galle Fort, one of Sri Lanka’s most treasured UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Walk through the cobbled streets, admire the colonial architecture, and enjoy the blend of history, boutiques, cafés, and ocean views that make Galle so distinctive. You may also visit a turtle hatchery en route or nearby, adding a conservation-focused coastal experience to the day.

Overnight stay in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Galle to Colombo – City Tour Experience
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, travel to Colombo via the Southern Expressway. On arrival, enjoy a city tour of Sri Lanka’s commercial capital. Visit major landmarks such as Gangaramaya Temple, Seema Malakaya, and Beira Lake, followed by Independence Square and the famous Jami Ul-Alfar Mosque, also known as the Red Mosque.

Colombo offers a lively contrast to the rest of the tour, with a mix of heritage, religion, colonial architecture, and modern urban life. A tuk tuk city experience can add a more local feel to the final city section of the journey. This day rounds off the route with a strong urban finale after culture, mountains, safari, and beaches.

Overnight stay in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Colombo – Shopping and Departure
itinerary.body:
On the final day, enjoy some free time for shopping or last-minute browsing in Colombo, depending on your departure schedule. This gives travelers the chance to pick up souvenirs, tea, local products, or gifts before heading to the airport.

Afterward, transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for departure, marking the end of your Best of Both Sri Lanka Tour — a complete journey through the island’s cultural heritage, hill country, wildlife, beaches, and city life.

title: Surf & Soul – Beach Focused Sri Lanka Tour
overview:
Experience the ultimate coastal escape with this beautifully curated Surf & Soul Sri Lanka tour, a boutique-style journey designed for travelers seeking surf, wellness, slow travel, and soulful beach living along Sri Lanka’s southern coastline. This 10-day Sri Lanka beach itinerary blends iconic surf towns, scenic bays, yoga-inspired stays, and relaxed coastal experiences into one unforgettable route.

Begin in Ahangama and Kabalana, where consistent surf breaks, stylish surf camps, and a refined coastal atmosphere make this stretch ideal for travelers who want to combine ocean energy with boutique comfort. Continue to Weligama and Mirissa, where gentle waves, wellness spaces, rooftop cafes, and beautiful beaches create the perfect balance between active mornings and relaxed afternoons. The route then moves deeper south to Talalla and Hiriketiya, two of Sri Lanka’s most loved bays for travelers seeking a more secluded and soulful coastal experience.

This Sri Lanka surf and wellness tour is designed for all levels, from beginner surfers looking to improve technique to experienced riders wanting access to famous breaks such as Kabalana. At the same time, the itinerary leaves space for yoga, recovery, healthy food, scenic beaches, and meaningful downtime. Optional wellness moments and nature-based detours, including a visit to Udawalawe National Park, can add another memorable dimension to the journey.

Perfect for couples, solo travelers, friends, and lifestyle-focused explorers, this Sri Lanka surf holiday offers the ideal mix of surf progression, oceanfront stays, wellness culture, beach cafés, and laid-back tropical living. It is the perfect route for travelers who want more than a beach holiday — a journey that feels both energizing and restorative.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Transfer to Ahangama / Kabalana
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide and begin your journey to Sri Lanka’s southern surf coast. Travel towards Ahangama and nearby Kabalana, an area known for its stylish surf culture, laid-back atmosphere, and beautiful beaches. This first leg of the tour is ideal for easing into the island’s coastal rhythm while settling into a boutique surf and wellness environment.

After check-in, the rest of the day can be enjoyed at leisure. Relax by the beach, explore the local coastline, or simply take in the atmosphere of Sri Lanka’s surf community. Ahangama offers a refined and intimate south coast feel, while Kabalana is especially popular among surfers for its consistent waves and ocean energy. This first day is designed to help you unwind after your flight and transition gently into a beach-focused journey of surf, wellness, and soulful coastal living.

Overnight stay in Ahangama / Kabalana.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Surf Progression and Wellness in Ahangama / Kabalana
itinerary.body:
Wake up to the sound of the Indian Ocean and begin your first full day on Sri Lanka’s south coast. This day is ideal for surf coaching, ocean practice, and slow recovery. Depending on your level, you may enjoy guided surf sessions at beginner-friendly or intermediate-friendly breaks in the Ahangama and Kabalana area. The region is known for its surf culture, community atmosphere, and access to multiple wave options along the coast.

Beyond the surf, this stretch is also ideal for wellness-focused travel. The atmosphere here supports a balanced routine of movement, nourishment, and rest. Spend the afternoon enjoying yoga, stretching, or quiet downtime by the coast. In the evening, relax at your boutique stay and enjoy the sunset over the Indian Ocean. This day is all about finding your flow — in the water and beyond it.

Overnight stay in Ahangama / Kabalana.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Coastal Lifestyle Day in Ahangama / Kabalana
itinerary.body:
Today offers more time to deepen the surf-and-soul experience. Enjoy another morning session in the water, continue improving confidence and technique, or simply enjoy the beach at your own pace. Ahangama and Kabalana are excellent for travelers who want surf access without giving up style, comfort, and an elevated coastal atmosphere. The boutique feel of the area makes it especially appealing for travelers seeking a more curated south coast experience.

The rest of the day can be used for beach cafés, slow lunches, yoga, or quiet relaxation. Whether you want a social surf setting or a more inward and restorative day, this stretch of the itinerary is designed to offer flexibility while maintaining a premium coastal feel.

Overnight stay in Ahangama / Kabalana.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Ahangama to Weligama – Beginner-Friendly Surf and Coastal Energy
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue east along the southern coast to Weligama, one of the most popular surf towns in Sri Lanka. Weligama Bay is especially loved by beginner and intermediate surfers due to its long sandy bay and more approachable wave conditions. This makes it an excellent destination for travelers who want to build confidence or enjoy more playful surf sessions in a welcoming environment.

After check-in, enjoy time at the beach, a surf session, or a relaxed afternoon exploring the area. Weligama also offers a lively but relaxed coastal lifestyle, with cafés, wellness spaces, and oceanfront viewpoints. This part of the route introduces a more social and energetic atmosphere while still keeping the beach-and-wellness balance at the heart of the trip.

Overnight stay in Weligama.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Weligama and Mirissa – Surf, Recovery, and Soulful South Coast Living
itinerary.body:
Today is designed around the blend of surf and recovery that defines this route. Enjoy another morning surf session in Weligama, then spend time unwinding with yoga, mobility work, or simply resting by the ocean. The Weligama–Mirissa stretch is ideal for travelers who want to combine active beach mornings with easygoing afternoons and a healthy lifestyle atmosphere.

Later, visit nearby Mirissa, where the coastline becomes more dramatic and scenic. Mirissa offers beautiful beaches, viewpoints, and a more romantic south coast ambiance. The transition between Weligama and Mirissa creates a great balance between beginner-friendly surf culture and more soulful coastal scenery.

Overnight stay in Weligama / Mirissa area.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Mirissa Slow Day – Optional Whale Watching or Wellness Time
itinerary.body:
This day gives you flexibility to experience Mirissa at your own pace. If traveling in season, whale watching can be arranged as an optional experience. Mirissa is one of Sri Lanka’s best-known coastal towns for marine excursions during the right season. Alternatively, this day can remain fully focused on rest, yoga, beach time, wellness, and enjoying the slower rhythm of the south coast.

You may choose to spend time at the beach, visit local cafés, or enjoy a quieter reset day before continuing into the deeper south. This gentle pacing is important for the “soul” side of the itinerary, allowing travelers to enjoy space, rest, and meaningful downtime between transfers.

Overnight stay in Weligama / Mirissa area.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Mirissa to Talalla – Secluded Beach Retreat
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue your journey south to Talalla, a quieter and more spacious beach destination known for its retreat atmosphere and sense of peaceful escape. Compared with busier surf towns, Talalla offers a more secluded experience, making it ideal for travelers who want to disconnect, reset, and enjoy a softer coastal rhythm.

The rest of the day is best spent at leisure — walking along the beach, enjoying yoga or wellness sessions, swimming in the ocean, or simply resting in a calm tropical setting. Talalla offers a very different energy from Ahangama and Weligama: less about movement and progression, more about restoration and stillness.

Overnight stay in Talalla.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Talalla – Optional Udawalawe Nature Detour or Full Retreat Day
itinerary.body:
Today can be shaped based on the traveler’s preference. For those who want to deepen the “soul” element of the journey through nature, an optional inland detour to Udawalawe National Park can be arranged. Watching elephants in their natural habitat offers a powerful and grounding wildlife experience that contrasts beautifully with the ocean-focused days of the tour.

If you prefer to remain on the coast, this day can instead be enjoyed as a full retreat day in Talalla with yoga, reading, beach time, swimming, or simple rest. This flexibility makes the itinerary suitable for different travel styles while keeping the overall tone refined and restorative.

Overnight stay in Talalla.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Talalla to Hiriketiya – Final Surf & Beach Escape
itinerary.body:
Travel to Hiriketiya, one of Sri Lanka’s most loved surf bays, famous for its beautiful horseshoe-shaped shoreline where jungle meets the ocean. Hiriketiya offers a stylish but relaxed coastal vibe and is especially appealing for travelers who want a final stretch of surf, beach cafés, and scenic tropical atmosphere. The bay is ideal for longboarding, mellow sessions, and relaxed south coast living.

Spend the day enjoying the beach, optional surf sessions, or a café-and-coast experience. Hiriketiya is also known for attracting a lively but intimate surf community, making it a fitting final destination before returning to Colombo. The combination of jungle-framed coastline, soft waves, and boutique beach culture makes this one of the most memorable locations on the route.

Overnight stay in Hiriketiya.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Hiriketiya – Return to Colombo Airport
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, begin the return journey to Colombo Airport. Depending on your flight schedule, the drive can be paced comfortably to allow a final look at Sri Lanka’s southern landscapes. This concludes your Sri Lanka surf and wellness journey — a route designed to combine movement, mindfulness, beautiful coastlines, and the lifestyle energy of the island’s south.

Transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for departure.

title: 9 Nights / 10 Days Sri Lanka Tea Trail
overview:
Discover the soul of Sri Lanka through this 9 Nights / 10 Days Sri Lanka Tea Trail, a carefully curated journey into the island’s misty highlands, colonial heritage, and world-famous Ceylon tea culture. This immersive experience takes you deep into the heart of Sri Lanka’s tea country, where rolling emerald plantations, scenic train journeys, and historic estates create a truly unforgettable travel experience.

Begin your journey in Kandy, the cultural capital of Sri Lanka and the birthplace of the country’s tea industry. Visit the historic Loolkandura Estate and the Ceylon Tea Museum, where the legacy of James Taylor comes to life. Continue through the scenic hill country to Hatton and Bogawantalawa, where you will stay in a traditional tea planter’s bungalow and experience the authentic tea-making process—from plucking “two leaves and a bud” to tasting world-class tea varieties.

Travel further to Nuwara Eliya, known as “Little England,” where colonial charm meets cool mountain air and lush tea estates. Visit Pedro Tea Estate, explore waterfalls, and enjoy high tea overlooking Gregory Lake. The journey continues with one of the world’s most scenic train rides from Nanu Oya to Ella, offering breathtaking views of valleys, tea plantations, and misty mountains.

In Ella, enjoy panoramic hikes, iconic landmarks like the Nine Arch Bridge, and modern tea experiences at Halpewatte Factory. Continue to Haputale, home to the legendary Lipton’s Seat, where Sir Thomas Lipton once surveyed his tea empire.

This Sri Lanka Tea Trail concludes with a journey back to Colombo, optionally visiting a low-country tea estate to experience rare Virgin White Tea production. This tour is ideal for travelers seeking culture, nature, luxury, and an in-depth understanding of Sri Lanka’s tea heritage.

itinerary.title: Day 1: & 2: Kandy – Gateway to Sri Lanka Tea Country
itinerary.body:
Your Sri Lanka Tea Trail begins in Kandy, the cultural capital and birthplace of the island’s tea industry. Visit the historic Loolkandura Estate, where James Taylor pioneered commercial tea cultivation in Sri Lanka. Explore the Ceylon Tea Museum, housed in a restored colonial tea factory, to understand the evolution of Ceylon tea.

Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, home to a diverse collection of tropical flora and spice plants. In the evening, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and experience a traditional Kandyan cultural dance performance. These two days blend tea heritage with cultural exploration.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 3: & 4: Hatton – Heart of the Tea Highlands
itinerary.body:
Board a scenic train from Kandy to Hatton, one of the most picturesque rail journeys in Sri Lanka, passing through lush tea plantations and misty mountains. Stay in a traditional tea planter’s bungalow surrounded by rolling hills.

Spend a full day with a resident tea planter learning the complete tea-making process. Experience the “two leaves and a bud” plucking technique, visit a working tea factory, and participate in a professional tea tasting session to understand different tea grades such as BOP and Flowery Pekoe.

Overnight stay in Hatton.

itinerary.title: Day 5: & 6: Nuwara Eliya – Little England
itinerary.body:
Travel to Nuwara Eliya, located at an elevation of 1,889 meters and known for its cool climate and colonial charm. Visit the famous Pedro Tea Estate and walk through scenic tea plantations. Take a short hike to Lover’s Leap Waterfall for panoramic views of the surrounding hills.

Enjoy a traditional high tea experience overlooking Gregory Lake and explore the town’s colonial architecture, gardens, and peaceful surroundings. These days provide a relaxed yet immersive tea country experience.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 7: & 8: Ella – Scenic Vistas and Tea Landscapes
itinerary.body:
Take the iconic train ride from Nanu Oya to Ella, widely considered one of the most scenic train journeys in the world. Travel through valleys, tea plantations, tunnels, and mountain landscapes.

In Ella, hike to Little Adam’s Peak for panoramic views and visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge. Explore the Halpewatte Tea Factory to gain a modern perspective on tea production while enjoying breathtaking views of the Uva region.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Haputale – Lipton’s Legacy
itinerary.body:
Travel to Haputale and visit Lipton’s Seat, the viewpoint where Sir Thomas Lipton once surveyed his tea empire. Walk through the historic Dambatenne Tea Estate and enjoy stunning 360-degree views of Sri Lanka’s hill country. This experience highlights the legacy of Sri Lanka’s tea pioneers.

Overnight stay in Haputale.

itinerary.title: Day 10: Return to Colombo & Departure
itinerary.body: Descend from the highlands towards Colombo. If time permits, visit a low-country tea estate such as Handunugoda to experience the unique production of Virgin White Tea. Continue to Colombo International Airport for your departure, marking the end of your Sri Lanka Tea Trail journey.

title: Sri Lanka Pilgrimage Tour
overview:
Embark on a spiritual journey through the sacred heart of Sri Lanka, exploring ancient temples, revered shrines, and historic cities rich in Buddhist heritage. This thoughtfully curated pilgrimage takes you across the island, offering a deep connection to centuries-old traditions, culture, and serenity.

Begin your journey in Negombo before traveling to the sacred city of Anuradhapura, home to timeless stupas and the revered Sri Maha Bodhi tree. Continue north to Jaffna, where unique cultural influences and sacred sites offer a distinct spiritual experience.

Explore the cultural treasures of Dambulla, including its iconic cave temples, and visit the majestic Sigiriya Rock Fortress and ancient ruins of Polonnaruwa. Your journey then leads to Kandy, where you will visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic—one of Buddhism’s most important sites.

Conclude your pilgrimage with visits to prominent temples in Colombo, reflecting on a journey filled with peace, devotion, and cultural discovery.

This tour is perfect for travelers seeking a meaningful spiritual experience combined with Sri Lanka’s rich history and timeless beauty.

title: Sri Lanka Honeymoon Escape
overview:
Celebrate love with this beautifully crafted 5 Nights / 6 Days Sri Lanka Honeymoon Tour, a romantic journey through Sri Lanka’s cultural highlands, misty tea country, scenic train routes, and breathtaking southern coastline. Specially designed for couples, this Sri Lanka honeymoon package combines heritage, nature, luxury, and unforgettable experiences to create the perfect romantic escape.

Begin your honeymoon in Kandy, Sri Lanka’s cultural capital, where you can visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic, walk hand-in-hand around Kandy Lake, and enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner overlooking the Mahaweli River. Continue into the cool hill country towards Nuwara Eliya, passing lush tea plantations, waterfalls, and botanical gardens that showcase the timeless beauty of Sri Lanka’s central highlands.

One of the most memorable experiences of the trip is the scenic Nanu Oya to Ella train ride, often described as one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world. In Ella, discover dramatic mountain views, the famous Nine Arch Bridge, and the picturesque landscapes of Sri Lanka’s tea country. The romance continues on the southern coast, where golden beaches, luxury stays, and ocean sunsets await in Mirissa or Tangalle.

Your honeymoon also includes a visit to the historic Galle Dutch Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site filled with colonial charm, boutique galleries, and stunning coastal views. Seasonal activities such as whale watching in Mirissa or a private Madu River safari can add even more unforgettable moments to your journey.

This Sri Lanka honeymoon itinerary is ideal for couples seeking a blend of culture, nature, scenic travel, and beach relaxation, all wrapped into one elegant and memorable holiday.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival & Kandy Experience
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide and begin your romantic journey to Kandy, the cultural capital of Sri Lanka. Surrounded by hills and rich heritage, Kandy is the perfect first stop for couples seeking a meaningful and elegant start to their honeymoon.

After reaching Kandy, visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of the most sacred Buddhist temples in Sri Lanka. This beautiful spiritual site offers a calm and memorable beginning to your honeymoon, and many couples enjoy receiving a blessing here for a meaningful start to married life. Later, enjoy a gentle walk around the scenic Kandy Lake, where the peaceful atmosphere and mountain surroundings create a lovely romantic setting.

In the evening, enjoy a private candlelit dinner overlooking the Mahaweli River, one of the most romantic experiences of the day. The combination of soft lighting, fine dining, and peaceful views makes this a special honeymoon moment. After dinner, retire to your boutique heritage property in Hantana for a restful overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Tea Country Journey
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, begin your journey into Sri Lanka’s misty hill country. Your first stop is the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, one of the most beautiful botanical gardens in Asia, known for its orchids, tropical plants, towering trees, and romantic garden pathways. This is an ideal stop for couples who enjoy natural beauty and photography.

Continue through the scenic mountain roads towards Nuwara Eliya, with visits to Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple in Ramboda and the beautiful Ramboda Waterfalls. As the journey continues, the scenery transforms into lush tea-covered hills, cool mountain air, and winding roads framed by breathtaking viewpoints.

You will then visit a traditional tea plantation and tea factory, where you can discover how world-famous Ceylon tea is made and enjoy a walk through the tea gardens. Upon arrival in Nuwara Eliya, often called “Little England,” enjoy the charming colonial atmosphere and a relaxing visit to Gregory Lake. Couples can enjoy lakeside walks and optional boat rides for a peaceful romantic experience.

Overnight stay in a colonial-style bungalow in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Scenic Train to Ella
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, transfer to Nanu Oya Railway Station and board the scenic train to Ella, often considered one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world. This unforgettable ride takes you through rolling tea plantations, cloud forests, mountain valleys, and charming villages, creating one of the most romantic and photogenic experiences in Sri Lanka.

Upon arrival in Ella, continue your honeymoon in this charming hill town known for its laid-back atmosphere and dramatic mountain views. Visit the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, one of Sri Lanka’s most photographed landmarks, surrounded by thick greenery and scenic rail lines. If you are feeling active, enjoy a short hike to Little Adam’s Peak, where panoramic views of the Ella Gap and surrounding tea country await. Sunset here is especially beautiful for couples.

Check in to your luxury hideaway in Ella and enjoy a peaceful evening in the hills.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Hills to Southern Coast
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, descend from Sri Lanka’s central highlands towards the southern coast. The journey itself is scenic, passing from cool mountain landscapes into warmer coastal surroundings. On arrival at your chosen beach destination, either Mirissa or Tangalle, check in to your romantic resort and unwind.

Spend the afternoon at leisure on the beach, enjoying the golden sands, sea breeze, and tropical atmosphere. This part of the journey offers the perfect honeymoon contrast to the cool hills of Ella. In the evening, enjoy a romantic seafood barbecue or private dinner by the beach under the stars, creating another memorable highlight of your honeymoon in Sri Lanka.

Overnight stay in Mirissa or Tangalle.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Galle & Coastal Bliss
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to enjoying the romance of Sri Lanka’s southern coast. Depending on the season and your interests, you may choose an optional whale watching experience in Mirissa between November and April, or a private Madu River safari through the mangroves for a quieter nature-based experience.

Later, continue to the historic Galle Dutch Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most charming destinations in Sri Lanka. Walk hand-in-hand along the cobbled streets, browse boutique galleries and local shops, visit the lighthouse, and explore the colonial architecture that gives Galle its timeless appeal. As the day comes to an end, enjoy the sunset from the fort ramparts, one of the most romantic coastal viewpoints on the island.

Overnight stay in a boutique hotel in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Departure
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, begin your return journey to Colombo via the Southern Expressway. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time for some last-minute souvenir shopping or a short stop in Colombo before heading to the airport. This final drive offers one last chance to reflect on the unforgettable experiences of your Sri Lanka honeymoon — from sacred temples and tea country landscapes to scenic train journeys, romantic beaches, and coastal sunsets.

Transfer to Bandaranaike International Airport for your departure, marking the end of your memorable Sri Lanka honeymoon tour.

title: Sri Lanka Surf Explorer
overview:
Discover the perfect balance of coastal charm, surf culture, heritage, and adventure with this Sri Lanka Surf Explorer. Designed for travelers who want more than a standard beach holiday, this journey blends boutique coastal living, beginner-friendly surf towns, scenic beaches, soulful escapes, and wildlife encounters along Sri Lanka’s stunning southern coastline.

Your journey begins in the historic Galle Fort, where colonial architecture, cobblestone streets, sea views, and boutique cafés create a stylish and memorable introduction to the island. From there, continue to the surf-and-lifestyle hubs of Weligama and Ahangama, where ocean energy, beach cafés, and easy access to surf lessons make this stretch ideal for both beginners and casual surfers.

The route then flows into the more relaxed and soulful south coast, with time in Mirissa and Hiriketiya, where tropical bays, beach culture, ocean views, and a slower rhythm create the perfect blend of activity and rest. From lively coastal mornings to peaceful afternoons by the sea, this section of the itinerary captures the essence of Sri Lanka’s surf-and-soul lifestyle.

To deepen the journey, head slightly inland for a memorable wildlife experience at Udawalawe National Park, one of the best places in Sri Lanka to observe elephants in their natural habitat. The itinerary concludes in Tangalle, known for its quieter beaches, golden sands, and luxury coastal atmosphere, making it the perfect final stop before returning to Colombo.

This Sri Lanka beach and adventure tour is ideal for couples, solo travelers, friends, and lifestyle-focused explorers seeking surf, heritage, coastal beauty, and a deeper connection to place.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Sri Lanka – Transfer to Galle Fort
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Bandaranaike International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private chauffeur-guide and begin your journey to Sri Lanka’s southern coast. Travel to the historic city of Galle, where your Surf & Soul experience begins with a refined blend of heritage, boutique charm, and coastal atmosphere. Galle Fort is one of Sri Lanka’s most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Sites and offers an elegant introduction to the island’s colonial history and modern lifestyle culture.

After check-in, spend the rest of the day exploring the fort at a relaxed pace. Walk along the cobblestone streets lined with boutique shops, stylish cafés, art spaces, and beautifully preserved colonial buildings. Visit the famous Galle Lighthouse and take in the ocean breeze from the fort ramparts, especially beautiful at sunset. End the day with dinner in one of the fort’s atmospheric restaurants or a relaxed evening by the sea.

Overnight stay in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Galle Fort – Colonial Charm and Coastal Leisure
itinerary.body:
Today is dedicated to enjoying Galle Fort in greater depth. Start the day with a peaceful sunrise or early morning walk through the historic streets before the town becomes busier. Visit heritage corners of the fort, explore local boutiques, and enjoy the easy rhythm of Sri Lanka’s most elegant coastal heritage town. This day allows travelers to experience a more refined and slower side of the south coast before continuing into the surf-focused part of the route.

Take time to enjoy local cafés, ocean views, and leisurely exploration around the lighthouse and seafront walls. This day works especially well for travelers who want a balance between culture, lifestyle, and downtime. Galle Fort offers the perfect beginning to a route that combines colonial atmosphere with coastal energy.

Overnight stay in Galle.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Galle to Weligama and Ahangama – Surf Coast Introduction
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue east along the southern coast towards Weligama and Ahangama, two of the most popular destinations on Sri Lanka’s surf-and-lifestyle circuit. Weligama is especially well known for its long sandy bay and approachable surf conditions, making it one of the best places in Sri Lanka for beginner and intermediate surfers. Ahangama offers a more stylish and boutique atmosphere, with a strong surf culture and a growing café scene.

On arrival, spend the afternoon settling into the coastal rhythm. Depending on your preference, this day can include your first surf session, beach relaxation, or simply exploring the cafés and boutique spaces that have made this stretch of coast so popular with travelers. The atmosphere here is youthful, stylish, and ocean-focused, offering the perfect transition from heritage-based travel to a more active beach lifestyle.

Overnight stay in Weligama / Ahangama.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Weligama and Ahangama – Surf, Cafés, and Coastal Lifestyle
itinerary.body:
Today is all about enjoying Sri Lanka’s south coast surf culture. Spend the morning at Weligama Bay, where gentle waves and sandy-bottom conditions are ideal for progression and confidence-building in the water. This is a great place for beginner-friendly surf sessions or relaxed time on the beach.

Later, explore Ahangama’s trendy coastal atmosphere, known for its stylish cafés, brunch culture, and surf-inspired lifestyle. The area is ideal for travelers who enjoy a more curated beach experience, blending wellness, design, food, and ocean energy. Whether you choose surf, brunch, photography, or simple beach relaxation, this day captures the lively and modern side of Sri Lanka’s southern coastline.

Overnight stay in Weligama / Ahangama.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Weligama / Ahangama to Mirissa and Hiriketiya
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, continue along the southern coastline towards Mirissa and Hiriketiya. Mirissa is one of Sri Lanka’s most loved beach towns, known for its lively coastal atmosphere, fishing harbor, beaches, and marine excursions. Hiriketiya, by contrast, offers a more intimate and beautifully curved bay framed by lush greenery, creating one of the most attractive beach settings on the island.

Spend the day enjoying the beach, ocean views, and relaxed south coast lifestyle. Mirissa offers vibrant energy, while Hiriketiya is more compact, stylish, and laid-back. Together, they create a perfect combination for travelers who want both atmosphere and beauty. The rest of the day can be spent swimming, relaxing, visiting local cafés, or simply enjoying the coastal scenery.

Overnight stay in Mirissa / Hiriketiya area.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Mirissa and Hiriketiya – Beach, Surf, and South Coast Soul
itinerary.body:
This day gives you time to enjoy Mirissa and Hiriketiya at a slower pace. Depending on the season, whale and dolphin watching can be arranged from Mirissa, as this stretch of coast is one of Sri Lanka’s best-known marine excursion bases. If you prefer to stay on land, the day can be focused entirely on beach time, surf, coastal exploration, and the easy atmosphere of the south coast.

Hiriketiya is especially appealing for its tropical bay setting and mellow surf culture, while Mirissa provides more beach activity and vibrant energy. Together, these destinations deliver the “soul” element of the itinerary — relaxed, scenic, and deeply connected to the ocean. This is a perfect day for balancing activity and rest before moving inland for wildlife.

Overnight stay in Mirissa / Hiriketiya area.

itinerary.title: Day 7: South Coast to Udawalawe – Wildlife and Nature Experience
itinerary.body:
Today you head inland for a completely different side of Sri Lanka. Travel to Udawalawe National Park, one of the country’s best wildlife destinations and especially famous for its elephant population. This inland detour brings a deeper nature dimension to the journey and offers a meaningful contrast to the beach-focused days of the tour.

On arrival, prepare for a safari experience in Udawalawe, where large herds of elephants can often be seen in their natural habitat, along with water buffalo, deer, birds of prey, and other wildlife. The open landscapes of the park make it one of the most accessible and rewarding safari experiences in Sri Lanka. This day adds emotional depth and a powerful sense of perspective to the route.

Overnight stay in the Udawalawe / Tangalle region.

itinerary.title: Day 8: Udawalawe Safari and Return to the Southern Coast
itinerary.body:
Enjoy the natural beauty of the Udawalawe area with the option of a morning safari or a relaxed wildlife-focused start to the day. Observing elephants in the wild is one of the most moving nature experiences in Sri Lanka and offers a memorable pause from the surf-and-beach flow of the route.

Later, continue back toward the southern coast and enjoy the scenery as the route reconnects with the ocean. This transition helps keep the itinerary dynamic, moving from colonial heritage to beach lifestyle to wildlife and back to coastal calm. The rest of the day can be spent resting and preparing for the final coastal stop.

Overnight stay in the Tangalle region.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Tangalle – Final Beach Escape and Return Journey
itinerary.body:
End your Sri Lanka journey in Tangalle, one of the most peaceful and beautiful beach destinations on the south coast. Compared with busier beach towns, Tangalle is quieter, more spacious, and ideal for travelers looking for a final luxury-style beach moment before departure. Its golden sands, calm atmosphere, and low-key coastal elegance make it a perfect last-night destination.

Spend the day relaxing by the beach, enjoying the ocean breeze, or reflecting on the experiences of the journey — from heritage streets and surf towns to wildlife and quiet southern shores. Later, begin the return drive towards Colombo via the Southern Expressway, depending on the timing of your departure or final overnight arrangement.

Return journey / departure arrangements as scheduled.

title: 6 Nights 7 Days Sri Lanka Tour
overview:
Discover the best of Sri Lanka with this unforgettable 6 nights / 7 days Sri Lanka tour package, carefully designed to combine culture, heritage, hill country scenery, wildlife, and beach relaxation in one seamless journey. This round-island experience is perfect for travelers who want to explore Sri Lanka’s most iconic destinations, from ancient temples and UNESCO World Heritage Sites to scenic train rides, lush tea plantations, national parks, and golden coastal escapes.

Your journey begins with a visit to the famous Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, followed by the historic Dambulla Cave Temple, one of Sri Lanka’s most impressive cultural landmarks. Continue to Sigiriya, home to the legendary Lion Rock Fortress, before heading to Kandy, the cultural capital of Sri Lanka, where you will visit the revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Kandy Lake, and enjoy a traditional cultural dance performance.

The tour then moves into the scenic central highlands, with stops at Peradeniya Botanical Garden, Ramboda Falls, Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple, and a tea plantation and tea factory in Nuwara Eliya. One of the highlights of the trip is the world-famous Nanu Oya to Ella train ride, offering breathtaking views of tea estates, misty mountains, and lush valleys.

From Ella, continue to Yala National Park for an exciting afternoon safari, where you may spot leopards, elephants, sloth bears, and many bird species. The adventure then shifts to the southern coast with visits to a turtle hatchery and the tranquil Madu River Safari, before concluding with a Colombo city tour featuring Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Square, Galle Face Green, and other key landmarks.

This Sri Lanka holiday package is ideal for couples, families, and first-time visitors looking for a well-balanced itinerary filled with culture, nature, adventure, and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Colombo Airport – Pinnawala – Dambulla
itinerary.body:
Upon arrival at Colombo International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your private driver-guide and begin your Sri Lanka tour towards the cultural heart of the island. Your first stop is the famous Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a unique conservation center dedicated to caring for orphaned and injured elephants. Here, you will witness these gentle giants bathing in the river and interacting freely in a natural environment, offering a memorable wildlife experience.

Continue your journey to Dambulla, where you will visit the magnificent Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site dating back to the 1st century BC. This impressive complex consists of five caves adorned with over 2,000 square meters of ancient murals and more than 150 Buddha statues. The temple provides a deep insight into Sri Lanka’s rich Buddhist heritage and artistic legacy.

After an enriching day of culture and wildlife, proceed to your hotel in Sigiriya/Dambulla for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Sigiriya – Kandy
itinerary.body:
After an early breakfast, climb the iconic Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress, one of Sri Lanka’s most celebrated landmarks and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Rising nearly 200 meters above the surrounding plains, this ancient rock fortress was built by King Kasyapa in the 5th century. As you ascend, you will pass the famous frescoes, mirror wall, and the grand lion’s paws before reaching the summit, where breathtaking panoramic views await.

Later, proceed to Kandy with visits to a spice garden in Matale, where you will learn about Sri Lanka’s world-famous spices such as cinnamon, cardamom, and pepper. Continue with a visit to a gem museum to discover Sri Lanka’s precious gemstones.

In Kandy, visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic (Sri Dalada Maligawa), one of the most important religious sites for Buddhists worldwide. Afterwards, enjoy a peaceful stroll around the scenic Kandy Lake. In the evening, experience a traditional Kandy Cultural Dance Show starting at 5:30 PM, showcasing vibrant Sri Lankan dance, drumming, and fire performances.

Overnight stay in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, renowned for its extensive collection of tropical plants, orchids, and towering palm avenues spread across 59 hectares. Continue your journey through the scenic hill country towards Nuwara Eliya.

En route, visit the Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple in Ramboda, a spiritual site surrounded by lush mountains. Stop at the beautiful Ramboda Waterfalls, one of Sri Lanka’s tallest waterfalls, cascading from a height of 109 meters.

Proceed to a tea plantation and tea factory, where you will experience the process of producing world-famous Ceylon tea and walk through the picturesque tea gardens. Upon arrival in Nuwara Eliya, often referred to as “Little England,” enjoy the cool climate and visit Gregory Lake, where you can relax or enjoy optional activities such as boat rides and lakeside walks.

Overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Nanu Oya – Ella Scenic Train Ride
itinerary.body:
Today you will experience one of the most scenic train journeys in the world. Board the train from Nanu Oya to Ella for a breathtaking ride lasting approximately 2–3 hours. This journey takes you through rolling tea plantations, misty mountains, valleys, tunnels, and lush greenery, offering unforgettable views of Sri Lanka’s hill country.

Upon arrival at Ella Railway Station, your driver will pick you up and continue your tour. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying the serene atmosphere of Ella, a charming mountain village surrounded by nature.

Overnight stay in Ella.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Ella – Yala National Park Safari
itinerary.body:
Begin the day with a visit to the famous Nine Arch Bridge, also known as the “Bridge in the Sky,” a stunning example of colonial-era railway construction surrounded by lush jungle landscapes. Continue to Ravana Cave, a historic site linked to ancient legends, and Ravana Falls, one of Sri Lanka’s widest and most beautiful waterfalls.

Later, proceed to Yala National Park for an exciting afternoon jeep safari starting at approximately 2:00 PM. Yala is Sri Lanka’s most popular wildlife destination and is renowned for having one of the highest leopard densities in the world. During the safari, you may encounter elephants, leopards, sloth bears, crocodiles, deer, and a wide variety of bird species in their natural habitat. The safari continues until around 6:00 PM, offering an unforgettable wildlife experience.

Overnight stay in Yala.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Yala – Bentota
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, travel towards the southern coastal town of Bentota. En route, visit a Turtle Hatchery, where conservation efforts are dedicated to protecting endangered sea turtles. Learn about the rehabilitation process and the importance of preserving marine life.

Later, enjoy a relaxing Madu River Safari, a scenic boat ride through mangrove forests and wetlands rich in biodiversity. This unique ecosystem is home to various bird species, reptiles, and aquatic life, making it an ideal experience for nature lovers.

Continue to Bentota and check in to your beachside hotel. Enjoy the rest of the day at leisure by the ocean.

Overnight stay in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Day 7: Bentota – Colombo City Tour – Departure
itinerary.body:
After breakfast, proceed to Colombo for a guided city tour of Sri Lanka’s vibrant commercial capital. Visit the Gangaramaya Temple, one of the most significant Buddhist temples in Colombo, followed by Seema Malakaya and Beira Lake, known for their peaceful surroundings and unique architecture.

Continue to Independence Square, a historic landmark commemorating Sri Lanka’s independence, and visit Galle Face Green, a popular seaside promenade ideal for relaxing and enjoying ocean views. You will also pass by the Old Parliament Building, a beautiful colonial-era structure with rich historical significance.

After completing the city tour, transfer to Colombo International Airport for your departure, marking the end of your unforgettable Sri Lanka journey.

title: 3 Nights 4 Days Sri Lanka Tour
overview: Perfect for travelers who want a short yet rewarding Sri Lanka holiday, this 4-day tour combines cultural landmarks, hill country charm, and coastal experiences. Visit Kandy’s sacred attractions, enjoy the cool climate of Nuwara Eliya, and unwind with Bentota’s river and beach activities before ending with a Colombo city experience.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Colombo Airport – Pinnawala – Kandy
itinerary.body:
Arrival – Pick-Up from Bandaranaike International Airport

Begin your Sri Lanka journey with a warm welcome and transfer from Colombo Airport towards Kandy.

10:30 AM – Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage

Visit the famous Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where orphaned and injured elephants are cared for. Enjoy watching elephants bathe in the river and interact in their natural environment.

1:00 PM – Visit Spice Garden (Mawanella)

Experience Sri Lanka’s rich spice heritage at a traditional spice garden. Learn about cinnamon, pepper, cardamom, and other spices used in local cuisine and Ayurveda.

3:30 PM – Arrival in Kandy & City Visit

Explore Kandy, the cultural capital of Sri Lanka. Visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic (Sri Dalada Maligawa) and enjoy a peaceful walk around Kandy Lake.

5:30 PM – Cultural Dance Show

Witness a vibrant Kandyan cultural dance performance showcasing Sri Lanka’s traditional arts and heritage.

7:30 PM – Dinner & Overnight Stay in Kandy

itinerary.title: Day 2: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya (Hill Country Experience)
itinerary.body:
7:30 AM – Breakfast & Departure

Depart Kandy and travel through scenic mountain roads towards Nuwara Eliya.

8:30 AM – Visit Peradeniya Botanical Garden

Explore one of Asia’s finest botanical gardens, home to thousands of plant species including orchids, palms, and medicinal plants.

11:30 AM – Visit Sri Bhakta Hanuman Temple

Visit this sacred Hindu temple located in Ramboda, surrounded by breathtaking mountain views.

12:30 PM – Ramboda Waterfalls Stop

Enjoy a scenic stop at Ramboda Falls, one of the tallest waterfalls in Sri Lanka.

2:00 PM – Tea Plantation & Factory Visit

Discover how Ceylon tea is produced. Walk through lush tea plantations and witness tea processing at a factory.

4:30 PM – Gregory Lake Visit

Relax at Gregory Lake, where you can enjoy scenic views, walking paths, and optional boat rides.

7:30 PM – Dinner & Overnight Stay in Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: Day 3: Nuwara Eliya – Bentota (Coastal Escape)
itinerary.body:
7:30 AM – Breakfast & Departure

Depart from Nuwara Eliya towards the southern coastal region of Bentota.

1:30 PM – Visit Turtle Hatchery

Visit a sea turtle conservation center where injured turtles are rehabilitated and hatchlings are protected before being released into the ocean.

3:30 PM – Madu River Safari

Enjoy a scenic boat ride along the Madu River, passing through mangroves and experiencing rich biodiversity including birds, reptiles, and aquatic life.

7:30 PM – Dinner & Overnight Stay in Bentota

itinerary.title: Day 4: Bentota – Colombo City Tour – Airport Drop
itinerary.body:
8:00 AM – Breakfast & Departure

Depart Bentota and head towards Colombo.

11:30 AM – Colombo City Tour

Explore Colombo’s top attractions including Gangaramaya Temple, Seema Malakaya, and Beira Lake.

1:00 PM – Visit Independence Square

Discover Sri Lanka’s historical independence monument and enjoy the surrounding gardens.

2:00 PM – Visit Galle Face Green

Relax at Colombo’s famous beachfront promenade and enjoy scenic ocean views.

3:00 PM – Old Parliament Building (Drive Pass)

View the historic colonial-era building with impressive architecture.

Drop-Off – Colombo Airport / Hotel

Transfer to the airport or hotel, marking the end of your unforgettable Sri Lanka journey.
